notes.title: Update 0.9.8 - Revolutionary New Fire/Smoke Simulation & Procedural Emergencies
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/W4LLnbEa_us

0.9.8 is live on all branches! A change log of all of the bug fixes and improvements can be found below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/5c9dd12a99a5b31678919369e675925ec7c415d5.png[/img]

[u][b]Revolutionary New Fire & Smoke Simulation[/b][/u]

Introducing a new realistic physics based fire simulation system powered by AI. This system allows for an ultra realistic fire and smoke simulation within EmergeNYC. Currently it is set up on all car fires, manhole fires, all new non structural fires and a small selection of building fires as I still have to convert each building fire to use this new system. Fire and smoke collides with walls, ceilings and more allowing for realistic simulation of smoke accumulation in a building and through rooms. I had to also redesign how you take smoke/fire damage. The new system uses a volume for each room in the fire and calculates smoke density and temperature as well as your proximity to the fire to calculate damage to the player. I made some improvements to the fire spread logic as well. Fires now only spread horizontal and up or just below them to other fire nodes but fire no longer drops down an entire floor. This system is still in the early testing stages to see how it performs across all hardware. More building fires will be added in the next updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/e2ac7d667d9bf1f82f37d65f03a34a68d9bfb7b4.png[/img]

[u][b]New Procedural Emergency System[/b][/u]

EmergeNYC now features a new procedural emergency system. This allows for virtually thousands of new calls across Manhattan, Brooklyn, and Montgomery County meaning you won’t have to respond to the same calls each playthrough. The new system is able to place emergencies in hundreds of different possible locations. The new system also automatically detects the emergency and generates the emergency information, address, box number, assignment and sends out the tones to the assigned units all procedurally. This makes adding new emergencies to the game much easier and faster so look forward to more new call varieties in bulk in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/8aadd0ba6d4542a33cf34ee1812738f7617f7054.png[/img]

[u][b]Redesigned Car Fires[/b][/u]

Random car fires can spawn on any road or parking spot on the side of the road. There are over 30 new vehicle fires with a dozen paint schemes for each vehicle. Cars can also spawn wrecked, flipped over, on their side and with or without victims inside. All vehicle fires now utilise the new fire system. You can open the doors, trunk, and hood of cars now by left clicking the door. Fire can hide in the trunk, hood, and inside the car. Car fires are more difficult now as they spread throughout the car and it takes longer to put out. There are new bus fires and garbage truck fires as well as a few other special vehicles.

[u][b]Redesigned Manhole Fires[/b][/u]

Manhole fires have been redesigned and can spawn on any of the hundreds of Manholes on the map instead of going to the same 4 or 5 manhole fires. Manhole fires now utilise this new fire system as well. Manholes will smoke and flare up and make realistic popping noises. Once a manhole fire reaches its max intensity, it will constantly shoot out fire and the next nearest manhole will explode and catch fire. This makes manhole fires more interactive and challenging. Manhole emergencies have been added to Montgomery County as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/0c08f17b00ed3a9580bc030d404fa6e7765d4970.png[/img]


[u][b]Other Non Structural Fires
[/b][/u]
Many other variations of rubbish fires have been added using the new fire system such as dumpster fires, trash/rubbish, scaffoldings, food stands, news stands and more.

[u][b]Procedural EMS Calls[/b][/u]

EMS calls are now also procedural. They can spawn anywhere on the street and injuries are completely randomised as well as the look of the patient. This means you can have thousands of unique EMS calls instead of the same ones every game.


[u][b]Other improvements and additions[/b][/u]

Improved the thermal imaging camera especially with the new fire system

Added walking pedestrians on all maps

A new way to play

This update completely changes how the game can be played and adds tons of Real Time Strategy style AI mechanics to the game. (ONLY IN BROOKLYN FOR TESTING)

AI Firefighters & Paramedics that can be controlled and given tasks from the RTS Camera or while in control of a firefighter.

notes.title: Upcoming April Update Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/abfc0a90936f336a82e167c5963d0ac5d26ea98d.png[/img]

Hello everyone! Just a development progress update for you all! If you have been following our discord  (https://discord.gg/G59T4rMrcJ)  you know a lot of things have been moving behind the scenes the last few months. I've taken the time to update the entire project to Unity 2021 which is the latest Unity engine. We have been running on Unity 2018 for most of the project. This task took me a few weeks to plow through all of the bugs and game breaking issues that arose because of the upgrade. While it was time consuming there are several benefits to the update. 

1. Build times in the editor went from 6-8 hours to only 15-30 minutes meaning that we are able to patch issues and fix bugs much much faster and save a ton of time that we used to have to wait for Unity to build out the game. 

2. With the new engine we have access to tons of new features, optimizations, assets, and a more much more efficient work flow.

3. The editor overall works much quicker meaning I can spend more time working and getting things done then waiting for things to load. 

[b]An update to all branches will be arriving within the next 2 weeks with all updates, fixes and changes including the Engine upgrade, sound improvements, optimizations and UI Redesign. The Personnel AI will NOT be included in this update as it is still heavily a work in progress. For previews view the linked youtube videos below[/b] 

 Below I am going to be posting all the small development progress updates that have been posted on discord since the last update here along with the dates they were posted in case you may have missed them. I avoid posting smaller dev updates on here to prevent crowding the big announcements. If you want to stay fully up to date with everything going on behind the scenes, be sure to join our discord and check the development progress channel.

You can also follow our trello which is updated with every task here: https://trello.com/b/WjeqOEsL/emergenyc-development-map

03/15

Hey @everyone , today I've got some gameplay clips to show you guys, specifically in regards to some changes to units and siren/horn sounds. First thing to mention is 234 has received a 2021 rig to match their real life counter part, of course the o
lder rigs are still available to use. Ladder 123 and 132 and Squad 252 have been updated to have chrome rims like their real life counter parts. On the sound side of things, With the doppler effect coming in this update, you can hear a difference in the sounds of the sirens and horns as the rig speeds up and hear how it echos and bounces off walls and streets. This is something that can be heard in real life, mostly from within the rig and is noticeable in game when in the orbit camera or interior views and responding at a fast speed. When outside of the rig though you will get the doppler effect we showed in the AI video in December. I've been working on ironing out issues and getting the game playable again within the updated engine. I spent some time today also trying to fix the editor infinite loading issue i've been having with no luck. I'm going to reach out to Unity about it and hopefully gain some insight on the cause. notes.title: First Look! 30 Minutes of Upcoming AI Update Gameplay
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JDD-jjc00f0

The upcoming AI update introduces true real time strategy gameplay to EmergeNYC. AI firefighters and paramedics can auto respond to calls on their own, follow commands, and assist you on the fireground. Firefighting is a team sport and up until now, the single player experience in EmergeNYC has consisted of trying to do everyone’s job alone. Now you can easily assign tasks to AI controlled companies and firefighters and complete all the objectives at a fire simultaneously. 

Real Time Strategy

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/5d77c03836857f88c5ca225fc9c7b6921fa58709.png[/img]

This update has taken all of my years of modding Emergency 4 and used those influences when creating the Real Time Strategy aspect of EmergeNYC. Since the beginning I’ve had the vision of blending the simulation genre with the Real Time Strategy genre and creating a strategy/simulation game where you can play as an incident commander with an overview of the scene, assigning commands to companies and members, while at any time being able to select any member or unit and control them directly. AI firefighters are capable of being assigned all of the same tasks that you have been able to do as a lone firefighter in the past. 
No longer do firefighters need to spawn in individually and despawn when you change roles. All companies are staffed when spawned and you can seamlessly switch between roles and AI will take over that firefighter instead of it being deleted. AI is toggleable meaning you can easily enable or disable AI firefighters and continue to play the game as you have since the beginning if you prefer.

Auto Respond

Units will auto respond to emergencies based on if they are on the run ticket. For every call I placed individual parking positions for all of the on map units to respond to. Companies will read the ticket and determine if they should respond as well as determine how quickly and if they should gear up depending on if the call is for a reported fire, or if it is a more minor emergency. No more needing to drive each company one by one to the call or place all of the respond to positions individually. If you are playing as an individual in a company, the AI will not drive off until all members are on the truck. If you are playing as the chauffeur of the company, all of the members will gear up and board the truck and wait for you.

Improved AI Driving

Since AI will be driving most of the time in the new update, I improved the driving mechanics and now companies can arrive much faster to emergencies with less margin for errors like crashing into trees and buildings. AI will now only brake at intersections they are going to be turning at and not every individual intersection which greatly reduces response times. Engine companies can swing turns with minimal braking which can get your units on scene much quicker than before. Options for different response speeds & urgency have been added. The slower speed has a slower max speed and move at the speed of traffic and have minimal siren and horn usage, while the faster option moves much faster and responds much more urgently with a lot of siren and horn. The normal option is somewhere in between the two.

Optimizations and Bug Fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/9ea7f7438f6f9b69b942e1647b9cb5219c5b24c5.png[/img]

I spent a lot of time optimizing the current mechanics of the game including vehicle physics, hoses, fires, and getting rid of some of the more severe lag spikes. There are still more things I can do to profile and eliminate and reduce lag spikes, frame loss, and memory usage and I will continue to improve on that aspect. So far the performance improvement has been a success in this update and allowed me to be able to fit all these units with entire staffed companies without causing significant frame loss. The majority of major issues from the previous Rescue Update have been fixed and will be included in the AI Update when it releases. Many people may have concerns over performance, crashes, and bugs and I am aware of each of these issues and working diligently to address them, clean up and polish the project while continuing to progress the game forward in the direction of progress and fulfilling my original promises of features in the game which include the AI and eventually the PD Mechanics which are some of the final things that need to be completed before we move into the alpha and beta stages and eventually a full release. There will be no new units or features that don’t contribute to the core purpose of the game being added as focus is shifting into completing the features and mechanics that we promised you at the beginning of the project, cleaning it up to run as smoothly as possible, and making the game an enjoyable experience. 

Recently assets that don’t belong in the game or are not properly licensed have been pointed out and acknowledged. Some GTA IV buildings that are in the game that were converted over from the EM4 Brooklyn mod back in the day and buildings with McDonald's logo, and citibank logo. A youtuber pointed out these issues recently so were going to address them and the assets and brandings will be removed from the game but will not impact any of the current gameplay. I want to make sure the project is heading in the right direction and avoid any shady business in the future.

https://gyazo.com/abb95168bea0c43891dd11a771a5ff2f

Progress with AI is well underway, in this gif you can see the Engine Rapid Deploy using the AI. The officer goes straight to the nearest burning fire. The Chauffeur (Driver) grabs the supply line and attaches it to the nearest hydrant. The Control man grabs the hydrant tool from the compartment and turns on the hydrant then goes to the hose bed. The Driver then goes to the pump panel and waits. The nozzle man goes to the hose bed and grabs a length of hose and then calculates the nearest burning fire and gets into position and stops within a safe distance from the fire. The backup man follows the nozzle man the entire time to back him up. Once the nozzle man is in position, the control man disconnects the hose from the hose bed and attaches it to the truck. Then the driver turns on the pump. The nozzle man crouches and begins to spray the fire. All of this is done with the click of one button. My goal with the AI is to automate as much of the process as possible but still leave room for the player to assume any role they want to.

The long awaited Rescue update is finally available for the public on all branches. We spent all of October working with our exclusive members and then opening up to the staging branch to track down the most problematic issues. While there are still quirks and things to be ironed out, I am confident that this update is ready for you guys to begin messing with and that it is more stable than the previous update. 

[b]What took so long?[/b]

Life changing things in my personal life arose in September and October which caused me to move back home and be with family as my future was uncertain. I was still working but the time I could put into the project was drastically reduced as I had other things that needed my focus. Now that those things have passed I have been able to get back to full time focus on the game.

[b]Where do we go from here?[/b]

I will continue to work on bug fixes, stability improvements, and performance improvements. While LC will continue doing his thing introducing new and revamped units, sound and lighting improvements and he’s now learning level design as he plans to add a Stillwater map to the game at some point in the future. 

I myself will be working on making sure that the EMS system functionality is fully completed and Firefighter AI is next up as my main priority now that I have the time and experience needed to fully accomplish that feature I previewed late last year. This will be something that really transforms the single player experience and if you haven’t seen the preview go check it out here: 

https://youtu.be/khPw2eg66AE

Once that is completed I plan on focusing on the Police mechanics of the game as it is the last department needing to be completed. Along with that will be additional rescue calls like water rescues and more that ESU will be involved in. Of course there are a ton of other things we are excited to eventually add such as throwback units which some have already been included in this update, map expansions, new firehouses, and units. But right now I want to get these main things out of the way first so the game can make the leaps it needs to make towards an eventual beta stage with all of the promised features. 

Thanks all of you for your continued patience. I hope you guys enjoy!

We've decided to move the staging branch into a development build status. The only downside to a development build is that whenever an error is thrown it will show up in red letter in a console on the bottom left.

The console is scripted to be closed every frame however if there is a repetitive script error running every frame it will stay showing the errors. The benefits to using development builds is that any script changes or fixes we do can be patched to the steam branches in a matter of 5-10 minutes over the 3 1/2 hours it takes to make the same fixes on a full build. Other benefits include being able to profile the development builds with Unity to profile for lag and spikes. Certain other changes and fixes such as fixes and changes to vehicle prefabs, emergencies, scenes etc need to have a full build redone as they are not included in script only builds. However many things are fixable through simply scripting a fix and can be patched in minutes with a development build. No more needing to wait hours for simple script change hotfixes.

What to do if an error is repeating in the console and won't disappear: click open output log and scroll to the bottom of the log to see which error is repeating its self and send it on any of our forums for me to fix the error and patch it.


LC has been behind the scenes improving upon the current MC units. The most significant change is his changes on Engine 2 to turn it into a Rescue Engine with extra tools and equipment. While doing so he went ahead and gave them a new color scheme and decals + lighting. He also experimented with Engine 1's color scheme which is not final and subject to change depending on the feedback from you guys. The fire chief SUV was given a maroon color. With all of these changes it made me wonder if I should implement a customization option for the fire units in MC to change things like the color schemes and siren + lighting packages. Let me know what you guys think of the idea.

In this patch my goal has been to add to and improve the quality settings menu to allow players, especially people having trouble running the game, to modify or toggle certain settings that are performance intensive in hopes that they can get improved performance with some of these changes. I also improved upon the Quality option which now are presets and effect all settings including the new ones. For example Very Low preset will disable things such as shadows, dynamic destruction, 3D Hose, charring effects, and lower your texture quality, while the ultra preset will max all those settings. Presets can be applied and then modified to exclude or lower specific settings. Optimization was another key goal in this patch and several optimizations were made. Along with these changes, several bugs have been addressed which can all be found below. We plan on continuing to optimize and improve the hose system, fix problematic bugs and start slowly shifting our attention to fixing the main multiplayer issues, EMS issues, and AI issues. Thanks for all your support! Were 1 week since the release of the update on the staging branch and already have 100+ fixes, changes, and optimizations logged over 6 different patches since. We don't plan on stopping!

notes.content:
Hotfix 0.9.0E is live and addresses the excessive amount of memory used causing issues with many players crashing when trying to load one of the larger maps with Full Resolution Textures. Before 0.9.0E the average RAM usage with all units spawned in and a fire loaded in Manhattan was 24GBs of Ram being used. Now that number has fallen to 15GBs in the same conditions. I went through every texture and sound file, and resized files that needed to be compressed and reduced in size while making sure essential and important textures and sounds kept their integrity. Also in this patch are more optimizations, bug fixes, multiplayer sync fixes and additions. Now that the memory usage has been addressed we are going to continue digging deep into the game to find root causes of performance issues and continue to optimize the game while beginning to address more Multiplayer issues, EMS issues and improving other things like the hoses. Thank you all for your patience through this testing phase and we promise more timely patches that continue to improve the stability and playability of the game.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.0C & Hotfix Live now on Staging Branch
notes.content:
Testing is going great, we are finding lots of issues and getting them addressed quickly as well as discovering a wide range of different performance across different systems. We are working quickly to get patches out to address your bug reports and things will be moving much quicker now that I'm back home in NYC as of today. Overnight I've published two builds. 0.9.0C and a hotfix to address some game breaking issues that came with that patch. We will continue getting more bugs fixed and optimizations done with more daily patches this week and weekend and hope to resolve the need for 32GBs of RAM with Full Res textures by resizing a lot of textures that do not need to be high quality, 
this will take a few days and then we will shift our focus onto getting Multiplayer stable and smoother as well as polishing the EMS issues and creating more EMS Calls. I hope you all continue to play and enjoy the update!

notes.title: EmergeNYC 2021 Update Public Testing Branch now Open!
notes.content:
The long awaited 2021 update for EmergeNYC is live now on the public staging branch! See instructions below how to switch to the staging branch!

https://gyazo.com/01d5db05bf2a6c8b94a2c8ef26f8fcc0

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1xFhVF65qKo

This is a TESTING branch meaning you will still find bugs, lag spikes, and possible crashes. The game is also still in pre-alpha early access. We are working around the clock and the game will be patched daily with fixes for bugs and other issues reported by the community to continue to improve the playability, stability, and performance. Things will start moving very quickly from this point on and we are super excited to finally have everyone try out the largest update to the game yet. 2 significant patches are already live in the first 6 hours since release. Change logs for those can be found all the way below.

A series of new tutorial videos will be going up tomorrow to introduce some of the new mechanics to players. 

Please report bugs, crashes, and other feedback on our discord where we are always active and in touch with our community and if you want or need immediate help: https://discord.gg/5mhbgJh

Coming Soon!

I'm happy to see how eager everyone is for the new update. The last 2 weeks I have spent working on expanding, improving, and adding to the EMS Mechanics of the game as well as introducing the basics to PD including a new deputy character for Montgomery County, fixing and improving current aspects of gameplay. I plan to fix remaining bugs before release of this huge update and make sure that all new things work as expected and do not bring new bugs into the picture. The next week and a half I will be out of town to spend time with my family back home for my birthday. There is still no estimated release date for this update. There is extensive testing taking place in private testing before we release so when release comes, most if not all gamebreaking bugs or annoying bugs have been solved. I want all things to work as expected in Single Player and Multiplayer. This update will bring back Montgomery County, add all the wildfire mechanics, and introduce nearly final EMS gameplay and the beginnings of the PD Mechanics. Once this update is out I plan to focus on a Rescue update that will entail Water Rescues, High Angle Rescues, Marine Operations as well as shifting focus to Police gameplay over everything else. Thanks again everyone for your patience!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.8.3Q is live! (Emergency Calls Fixes) + Need your help!
notes.content:
Happy 4th of July everyone! We hope you all enjoy your holiday. In this hotfix I addressed an issue where some emergencies wouldn't work and some would not be synced in Multiplayer. The issue stemmed from some change in the code I made so that the Fire Academy scenarios would sync properly. I adjusted the code some more to maintain that fix and the emergencies in Brooklyn should work as expected now. 


I need your help. The next issue we want to look into is solve is the many reports from some users crashing while loading the game. If you are someone who has this issue we need your help to solve it. 

1. While loading, open task manager (Ctrl + Alt + Delete) Click the performance tab. Leave this open while loading to see if anything is using over 90-100%. Pay close attention to CPU, GPU and Memory usage.
2. Many people report having performance issues with EMERGENYC. This may be caused by the game itself but may also be related to your PC components and we would like to try to help the community figure this out. If you would like to benchmark your PC and receive some feedback on what may need upgrading in regards to your PC components, please run this free benchmark below. 
Steps:
1. Click on the link below to download the benchmark
2. Make sure NOTHING is open in the background
3. Run benchmark
4. Once the benchmark is complete it will open a webpage with your results, please post the URL to that webpage in this text channel
5. Wait for benchmark to be reviewed and feedback will be given via PM.

https://www.userbenchmark.com/resources/download/UserBenchMark.exe

3. After crashing, send us your crash files located here: C:\Users\YOURNAME\AppData\LocalLow\FlipSwitch Games\EMERGENYC
If you are unable to find it, type "%APPDATA%" in the windows file explorer directory bar.
Send us the error.log and or crash.dmp so we can try to track down the source of the crash and fix it asap!
Once we are able to figure out the source of the crashes for these users, we will be able to fix it. Thanks!

[u][b]Highlights[/b][/u]

Added real life pictures in each firehouse of the companies

[u][b]Critical Fixes[/b][/u]

Redesigned the Emergency System (This should hopefully fix the problem some people have been having forcing calls)
Volumetric Clouds are off by default now (To save lower specs performance & prevent DX12 users from running into the black glitch)
Redesigned the cool down option for the Emergencies to work as intended (Cool down will only last until the emergency is fully loaded to prevent anything from breaking the loop)
All fire victims and roofs will be deleted when their respective emergency is cleared (This should fix the issue when you try to carry a character and they float in the air in place)
First Person Camera when driving will now face forward by default (No need to adjust it every time)

Fixed the Key binding menu being behind other UI causing trouble accessing it

[u][b]Multiplayer[/b][/u]

Added important information/rules for multiplayer games in the lobby to help avoid players running into issues in Multiplayer
Once a server starts, it should no longer be visible in the lobby search (To prevent the unavoidable lag and unsynchronized issues of joining a lobby in progress)
Fixed PASS Alarm going off while driving in Multiplayer
Added a refresh of the roles menu every 3 seconds (This should fix roles not being cleared when leaving or switching roles)

[u][b]Changes[/b][/u]

Added a pop out option to the Unit Spawn menu for those reporting its too small and unreadable, it will move it to the middle of the screen and scale it up to make it much more legible

Made the Deck gun and Tower Ladder streams much more defined and reach further for long distance spraying

notes.title: Brooklyn Update 0.8.3 is Live!
notes.content:
Our biggest update to date is now live on all branches! Please read all of this while downloading. 

Welcome to Brooklyn, the Borough of Fire.  Brownstones, Tenements, Taxpayers, Projects, Private Dwellings, Warehouses. Brooklyn is the opposite of Manhattan’s bustling streets, avenues, and highrises. The Bedford Stuyvesant/Crown Heights areas of Brooklyn are notorious for their volume of working fires each year.

What's New and What's Fixed?

Our main goal this update was to address the two main issues. Bad Performance, and Multiplayer. This update does just that. I was able to find the main components attributing to the lag and redesigned them to work more efficiently. The performance is day and night now for MUCH smoother gameplay. This is the optimization update everyone has been waiting for. 

Second, we all know firefighting is not a one man job. It’s a team effort. The ways that we can simulate that in our game is via AI firefighters, or having your friends (or strangers) join you in a Multiplayer lobby to team up and work together. Multiplayer is a completely new and finally enjoyable experience. The lag, unsynchronized mechanics, and game breaking bugs are no more. The game runs as smooth as a single player game and 95% of all mechanics are synced and work as they should. Below you can find a full changelog of Update 0.8.3

But first, a Note from Raf:

Firstly I want to thank everyone who plays or has played this game. You guys have given me the opportunity to do what I am passionate about and what I am good at and I live a happy life to be able to wake up excited everyday to bring this vision to life. This is my life’s work and I am extremely proud of it. From the start, the game has received mixed reputations of being a laggy buggy mess, and that's fair. It was. This project has been a learning process for me and I can say confidently that I am much better at my job than I was in the past. Over the last 2 months I have learned so much when it comes to game development. Something in me just took over and my brain turned into a sponge. I learned how to code, I dug into the core of the game to find the main issues that would break the player’s experience. We all know what that is; game breaking bugs, unbearable lag, and a horrible multiplayer experience. But through these years of learning as I go, throwing a hail mary, and hoping for the best, literally dedicating my life to this. So many of you have seen the same vision that I have. Thank you, and I hope that this is the update that can really get the game to where it should be. At this point, I can confidently say that EmergeNYC is, without a doubt, the best Emergency/firefighting game/sim out. There have been many respectable attempts like Notruf 112, “Firefighting Simulator” which hasn’t posted a word since 2017, Into the flames, which is promising but still is years behind. I feel proud and honored to be the individual leading this genre right now.

notes.title: EmergeNYC Brooklyn Trailer & News Update
notes.content:
EmergeNYC Brooklyn Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fZ54j1WwN7Y

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/9b8f9f9ac484ffc12aff81415e8378ae0f5d8e8a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/0e5531a0f228345f2b46ef21b9c3d47a92c1dc2e.jpg[/img]

I'm excited to officially announce that Brooklyn is coming to EmergeNYC. Our 3rd Free Map addition to the game is the result of a group of community members and I working together to bring this idea to life. Loosely based off the area we made for the Borough of Fire Modification for EM4, this map is a near 1 to 1 scale of the Bed Stuy area of Brooklyn, NY. This update will also be our biggest optimization and bug fix update yet. We reworked multiplayer from the ground up and eliminated all the performance issues associated with it. We were able to improve all aspects of multiplayer and the overall game is much better than last month's update.

We still have a few things to fix and get right before we release the update to everyone. We optimized many other parts of the game which means everyone all across the board should have better performance.

While better performance is a plus, the game looks much better. We added new post processing effects such as depth of field, and improved our already existing ones. On top of that, all emergency lights now reflect on the ground and on walls and other surroundings.

Traffic has been substantially improved with vehicles now moving out of the way of emergency vehicles and even if the car is coming at you head on. The overall multiplayer experience is much much better on all maps and we are really excited to give you all these fixes and improvements.

We have fixed nearly every bug reported to us and the overall experience is much more enjoyable overall.

notes.title: Update 0.7.9B is Live! Lots of bugs fixed! New Game Mechanics added!
notes.content:
*Mac Users, we are aware of the issues that arose in the last update. We are addressing them and will have a Mac Build up sometime this weekend*

Good morning everyone! I'm excited to publish the first update for our major update 0.7.9B which was released last week. I spent this week thoroughly testing and revising bug reports and suggestions and working on fixing, adding, and tweaking the game. A few big changes have been added in this update.

The first thing I want to show is the new damage visualization system. 
We have increased the damage and proximity you take from fires to make it more dangerous and realistic.
Before, there was no indication that your character was being hurt or dying. Now, we have added an obvious screen effect which gets more intense the longer you are being injured. Also added, is a breathing and heartbeat sound effect as you get closer to dying.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/f24af5c652b3b4cb4984f3e77acca8e6ab214bf2.jpg[/img]

We also tweaked the air system to have the shaker sound once you reach low air. This is still a WIP and some of you will notice that. Should you run out of air simply re spawn your character. We are currently working on adding an option to refill your Air at any of the trucks. In the mean time, air is no longer refillable just by walking outside. Think of it as a stamina/air bar. Once your firefighter is drained, respawn a fresh one. We will make this more practical in the next patch with the option to refill your bottles and stamina.

Next we added several new building fires. 3 new House fires in the Fire Academy Neighborhood and 1 new house fire in Manhattan. We are currently working on 2 new House fires in a new neighborhood you will notice was added to Montgomery county.

notes.title: Montgomery County Update Released for Public Testing! (Staging Branch)
notes.content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6ZE0-Msozh0

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/61ca2dd4107495fe310fb8e4a971876dc05bd0fe.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/094a144866e0e58afd50812377532de9b1dc94b3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/f83c7fc7ba2683fb4538a40aa642fdc1b6c6a34e.jpg[/img]

The highly anticipated release of Update 0.7.8 is here! You heard that right. Montgomery County is here! Just in time for the Christmas Sale starting tomorrow morning. EmergeNYC will be 20% off (20$ USD) through January 2nd 2020. Switch to the Staging Branch to start your download now! 

View the full changelog here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1KWPEdrBo-45zmnZXZNx-CSv38wWCc0yafiA5nu8AJGM/edit?usp=sharing

This is v0.1 of our Montgomery County map meaning there are only about ~40 emergencies and just as many bugs. We want to welcome our players in to the testing and polishing phase of Montgomery County. We know you guys have waited impatiently for months and months for a release and we kept saying “give us just a little longer” Well, the end of the year creeped up on us and we feel like we haven’t delivered what our community expects from us. We feel comfortable that we have squashed so many of the game breaking bugs and feel that gameplay is virtually stable. I have decided to abandon the hope of delivering a perfect product polished and all to you guys and want to welcome everyone into the testing phase to find the problematic bugs and get feedback on ways things should work. This game has been built on community feedback and bug reports and we are excited to move into the next stage of development.

As after every big update, we will be patching the game daily and making fixes and changes based upon all of your feedback and reports.

Multiplayer is disabled in this build while we want our players to solely test the single player gameplay to help us find bugs and provide important feedback to continue to improve the game with each hotfix. We are also working on several Multiplayer issues that render it unplayable at this time. 

This update has been in the works since earlier this year and I have faced tons of criticism and accusations that I figured now would be a good time for me to address. 

“These developers are so stupid adding new things when they need to fix the broken game”

While deciding to go through with the idea for Montgomery County may not have been the right timing, I still feel as though this update will hopefully be a breath of fresh air to our players who have been waiting for new content. People were claiming that we were solely adding things and have abandoned the original Manhattan map which is as far from the truth as possible. Manhattan has new emergencies, countless bug fixes (As you can see by the 8 page change log below) as well as the Fire Academy. The game all around has seen tons of fixes and improvements, but is still far from perfect.

“This game is a scam”
	
Believe it or not, it’s not a scam. I am not here to take your money, hence the huge free update! I am a sole individual running and creating this game with little to no outside help lately. It is difficult to work the hours I do and try to please every one of you with an explanation or a response. I do this not for the money, but because I love this game and what I have built from the ground up with many of you who have been here since the very beginning. It is easy to say hateful and ignorant things when you don’t know what has to go into something of this scale. 

“This project is dead”

	Many have began spreading these rumours, which I take blame for not having been communicating better these last few months while trying to get the game to a place where it is stable enough to replace 0.7.7J. So many new issues arose, game breaking bugs that took weeks to fix, it was nightmarish where i’m sure any other single game developer would have pronounced the project. But that is not an option for me. This is my livelihood and the only way this project will die is if I die or get locked up. Progress maybe slower than what everyone wants, but it is moving a long as is already leaps ahead of most of the competition.

Hey everyone, just an update on progress towards release. The remaining critical issues are problematic because they only happen in the build and work perfectly fine in the editor. I am leaving to NYC for the weekend and coming back Tuesday to meet with some FDNY Personnel about potential plans in the future for VR implementation to be possibly used in drills. I will also be doing my usual buffing and stopping by firehouses. I had originally planned to take my PC with me to be able to work on the go but decided the risk of my PC being broken while traveling was way too high and if anything were to happen to it, it would severely delay the release of this update. I will be taking my Laptop to see if there are options for me to work over the cloud remotely.

So long story short, only a few game breaking issues remain, not a simple fix, need to dig into why the issues are only happening in the build and not in the editor. Will be gone for 5 days in NYC, not taking PC as its too risky to try to travel with and risk breaking it. Donut will be digging into the issues over the weekend. Our goal, as every year is to have the update ready for this year's Christmas sale. That is the goal! Stay tuned for further updates!

Thank you all for your patience again.

notes.title: Update on approaching release of 0.7.8!
notes.content:
My steam people! I know our last update to you guys was in September. Before you guys read the below message. I sincerely want to apologize for not communicating efficiently in this community. The amount of negative feedback on this platform from reviews, to discussions really takes a toll on me mentally. So I haven't been keeping up to date with a lot of your comments and concerns in the discussions and instead my staff have been keeping me on the need to know. A lot of the things posted here can get really personal, hateful, and it really is discouraging at times. But besides that we have been hard at work and have an update for you guys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26753975/2a3a4c22a265547836865d41e818916236d7df0f.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone! I wanted to give you all an update. I know so many of you are skeptical, frustrated, angry, disappointed, and many other verbs. Especially with my lack of communication with the community especially on our Steam Page. First of all this will be pretty lengthy so take a seat. I want to thank my Support team for doing an incredible job this month. I am not sure of the specifics of the stats but we have fixed over 250 (Two hundred and fifty) bugs since 0.7.7J. The game experience you will all have in 0.7.8 will be much smoother and stable than any update in the past. We are still in closed testing and making leaps of progress everyday. Every day new bugs are reported and are fixed but our main concern has been the game breaking issues, things that will completely ruin your experience and make you want to throw your PC out a window, and oh boy did we run into those.

Just an example of some of the issues we ran into and got stuck on, some for weeks even. Things that worked perfectly and just broke and ceased to work. Fires just stopped working and wouldn't be extinguished by water causing us to have to update the code to be more reliable, Police cars and EMS vehicles spawning system broke preventing you from being able to drive the vehicles. Tower Ladder Nozzles and Deck guns broke. Item pick up broke. I could go on and on. These are things we did not foresee but happened and caused delays in the development of not just Montgomery County but the huge update we plan on releasing very soon, like in the next week or two. Maybe even sooner, I cannot tell you guys anything concrete because who knows if anything major will break next, but we are at a point now in testing where these game breaking bugs have been weeded out and now we are just left with a list of mostly cosmetic and minor issues. Things that wont break your game and prevent you from enjoying the game. In the past we approached this process much differently.

We didn't have a support team before who goes out of there way and dedicates hours of their day to testing, writing bug reports, breaking the game, helping others with their issues, and helping me get this project done. Before we would just hope that things worked the way they should and let all our players test, and the results were a lot of complaining, frustration, etc. Now that we have a dedicated testing team, we are able to find all these bugs before our player base finds them and allows us to not be overwhelmed with issues and reports when we put an update out on the staging branch or public branch. We are hard at work everyday, just because I haven't posted much in here does not mean things are not progressing. Many people can attest to that.

Our game plan as of a few days ago, we decided we will be releasing an update on all branches which will include the hundreds of bug fixes and improvements for the Manhattan and Fire Academy maps. The Fire Academy will also include all of the new Montgomery County vehicles for you all to become familiar with while we move into the next stage which is VIP Montgomery County Map testing. We will be polishing that and making sure it is ready for you guys. Support can tell you it still needs some work but so many of you are convinced that we dropped Manhattan for this new map which is not true at all. In fact 90% of the bugs we have fixed come from the original maps.

We are down to like 3 game breaking bugs, being 1. if you have more than 5 vehicles spawned, doors and compartments start to dissapear off of trucks preventing you from accessing the items inside, 2. When exiting a vehicle you can still control it, and 3 some item positioning on the new firefighter model causing issues. Once we get those figured out which shouldn't take too much longer, we will be golden for a release of 0.7.8 FINALLY which will address so many issues you all have been having. I hope you all can forgive my absence in the community, but I have not been absent from developing. I promise you guys once this update is released, it will hopefully change a lot of people's perceptions on the game and on me. It has taken so long because I do not want to make the same mistakes I did in the past by releasing broken updates without testing thoroughly and man, this update has been tested thoroughly for weeks so it will be a much better and more stable experience than any update we have put out in the past. If you have any other questions or concerns please contact me or a staff member and I will do my best to get back to you ASAP!

Love all you guys, even the haters!

notes.title: Update 0.7.7F is Live on all branches! + New Map Details and Screenshots
notes.content:
New Map Details & Screenshots

If you are a member of our discord: https://discord.gg/xZvGDnX

You may have already heard we will be adding a new map to EmergeNYC. The map has already been completed and was provided by Unity as a complete asset. It is a much smaller, spread out, and rural based environment with a main interstate, small downtown area, and plenty of forest and farm land for a wide variety of different types of emergencies. Our goal with this map is to appeal to the audience who prefers small towns and rural areas over large urban landscapes like our current Manhattan map. Units on this new map will be completely fictional and different from our NYC based units currently. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/98d5bf003b0902b5aed23faa740663171f540834.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/4d7441b8865577b0a8df1698cbd449c6e2b143d8.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/d3640077241119074062d744982eeab6e1778570.jpg[/img]


There will be approximately 5 fire department vehicles including a Tanker, Quint, and brush truck. A small police force, and a fire department based ambulance. This new environment gives us the opportunity to experiment with new emergencies such as brush fires, missing people, and more. Our main goal with this new map is to provide a breath of fresh air to our players, especially those who are from areas like this. A reminder, as many may complain that we should be focused on more important things. As we mentioned earlier, this map was provided at no cost to us, generously by Unity. No hours have been put into creating it. We aim to have the first version of this new map playable by the end of the month with its new units. 

As for 0.7.7F

We apologize for the delay on this patch. We decided to update to Unity 2019 from 2018 with the hope that we could utilize its new optimizations, however after updating we spent several days trying to fix new errors and issues that came with the update. Unfortunately, it would take a good amount of time to solve the issue and we wanted to keep patching the game, we reverted back to 2018 and now have update 0.7.7F live on all branches. Donut will continue solving issues that have arose with 2019, while I will continue to patch and fix issues in 2018 and provide updates and patches.

Update 0.7.7F is our second patch with the main focus on optimizing the game experience. In the last optimization patch we were able to significantly reduce loading times. With this patch, we have taken time to track down the majority of random lag spikes and their causes and address them. Our next optimization patch will solely focus on improving the overall frame rate of the game. Along with optimization we have been able to fix a good amount of bugs and make a few changes. A full change log can be viewed below.

notes.title: 0.7.7A Live on All Branches, Fixes Loading Issues and Locking up after Loading
notes.content:
*NOTICE 0.7.7 UPDATES WILL BE MOSTLY OPTIMIZATION AND BUG FIXING*

0.7.7A Is live on all branches and includes a quick temporary fix to fix the locking up issue after loading. We had to remove the entire underground subway system as well as several other environments and emergencies until we can fix the issue. You wont really notice any difference in the game except much quicker loading times and better performance. Thanks for all your patience as we continue to optimize and improve the game.

 0.7.7A 

Solved an issue where game would lock up immediately after loading
Temporarily Removed several interiors, emergencies and more to prevent crashing
Fixed some strange materials on NYPD Officer
Finalizing Loading Screen
Fixed PD Customization Menu being on when loading

0.7.7 is live and is our first major update in terms of optimization. There are two things we need to address with optimization and that's loading times, and FPS. This update has virtually solved all loading time issues. Our next step is refining fixing loading, this includes eliminating lag spikes when spawning a unit or character. Next is optimizing performance wise. Since Last update, loading times were past 20 minutes. As of 0.7.7 load times range from 40 seconds to 4 minutes. Let us know how long it takes for you to load in! Also included in this patch are several fixes to bugs. Change log below: 

0.7.7

/Extremely improved Loading Times
/Add new tutorial system and documentation
/New Loading Screens
/Fixed Blurry EMS Handbook Text
/Fixed Building 3 exploding on start causing Lag
/Fixed EMS Bag Pickup Missing Icon
/42nd St First Floor Fire Ticket Mistake

notes.title: 0.7.6 Development Update
notes.content: Good morning, Happy Saturday everyone. Just an update on 0.7.6. We have made huge leaps of progress on 7.6 in terms of optimization, multiplayer gameplay, and new content. 7.6 will reimplement a functioning and enjoyable Fire Academy & Manhattan Multiplayer experience, offer hours of new Fire Academy Scenarios to practice on, and a much smoother gameplay experience in Manhattan as we have put countless hours into improving performance, reducing crashes, and adding new emergencies. The developers of the rope physics system we are using for our hose physics have recently released a new version which we are working on redesigning and implementing this new optimized and more efficient system with new possibilities to have the hoses behave much more realistically and less erratically. 0.7.6 will be live on the staging branch soon. Thank you all for your patience while we work on ironing out the game so that it is a more rewarding and enjoyable experience rather than frustrating, repetitive and annoying.

notes.title: 0.7.6 First Look! Huge Fire Academy Overhaul
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/b6f506dcaad57f83bfa23dcd6e5ba2ae4270a53b.jpg[/img]

Hey, everyone! I've been working on overhauling the fire academy to give it a little more..... substance? I've been studying the actual fire academy located on Randall's island and finding new things I could add to fill much of the emptiness in the academy as well as add more gameplay and variety to the map. So a long with different car accident scenarios, the return of car fire and bus fire scenarios, EMS training scenarios, we have added some pretty cool new stuff. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/f7e29d2633b46d428a9d3a87d5c98c17da4aac5e.jpg[/img]

6 new buildings have been added so far with more coming. 

1. A Victorian style private dwelling, complete with a full interior including an attic. This will make for some really difficult and aggressive firefighting. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/cf4cc3f8fd46cd6d11887e70bc15a62e409f2fa0.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/988a4f959cdd490bd4dc9f32017081b0deffe34f.jpg[/img]

2. A 2 1/2 story Private Dwelling complete with a basement and terrace. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/c2dc0c8fccd97601c035b0a1856c5efa5da2cecc.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/2db57480890faf4223947af3c147923687c6d545.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/41f0b952ae1ee9303d4d301e120deae1627ea813.jpg[/img]

These types of PDs are found all over Queens, Brooklyn and the Bronx. Interpret what you may, but this new building along with the others will require different strategies and ways to attack the fire.

 3. A huge Factory with tons of different possibilities for scenarios. This building is good for training on finding your way out of a maze. The building is huge and has tons of different rooms, stairwells, hallways etc.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/658ca2a0e8fcf2e837e16eca710f64d3f634a834.jpg[/img]

 4. 2 Warehouse buildings which give you access to the new Subway Simulator under the Fire Academy. This is an entirely new and super detailed subway station where you and others can train on several different underground fires which are a bit more complicated then those above ground. You can also train on Subway rescues such as someone pinned under the train or in between the train and the platform.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/f0290bc0e3419e7e97a4c776327cb27b4a4f458b.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/227c7f2db96a8f7020ca9ed385ee4a5a07d6ac32.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/b8057e50a8361fc5849a9030cf8bef997fa7f048.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/536f46649298a1fc1dc5063599cdae3244335d91.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/0abd34f0b26d7e823eee80bf4b36ceda22d9078f.jpg[/img]

 5. We finally added a much requested "garage" where all units will spawn in the Fire Academy rather than spawning in the middle of a parking lot. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/f589e4097ebdf9aba46ef021dc0347379bd5bd6b.jpg[/img]

Last but not least is the Field House. At this current point in time I'm not 100% what I am aiming at with this field house but it is something that the FDNY has at the academy. An indoor movie set style recreation of a street with store fronts and mock buildings. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/519667d73123063963881fc430088354ff194d9c.jpg[/img]

Feel free to leave some input on what we can do in here. Overall though, 2 days in. The Fire Academy looks much better and has much more material and substance to it. Hope you all are excited for 0.7.6!

Many of you might be concerned about my priorities of what I should be working on. Working in the Fire Academy allows me to prototype, test, and fix features much quicker than in the Manhattan map. The benefit is that anything in the Fire Academy can be reused in the city with only a small amount of tweaking. With all of these new additions, the Fire Academy still runs very smooth with little to no difference in performance.

Our search for a new developer to solely focus on Optimization and improving the game's performance has led us to someone who is in the process of familiarizing themselves with the project. From there he will move into advanced profiling to locate exactly the main problematic areas and find the quickest and easiest ways to address them. We are excited for 2019. Lots of cool stuff coming guys! Stay tuned.

VIP Members, you will have access to an early version of the new Fire Academy at the end of the weekend.

0.7.6 will then move into staging shortly after and we will work our way into a public release.

Remember to follow our Trello Road Map to see what we are working on and what is all on our to do list: https://trello.com/b/WjeqOEsL/emergenyc-road-map

notes.title: Statement from FlipSwitch Games
notes.content:
TL:DR

https://youtu.be/x4mXjRr1Euo

This statement is to address a few misconceptions about FlipSwitch Games and EmergeNYC.

An issue we have struggled with over the 2 year course of our development is keeping our community happy. 

Many players are extremely frustrated, feel ripped off, or confused because of a lack of engagement or progress. This is understandable and we feel this is due to our inability to stay connected with the wide variety of platforms that our community have to communicate with us and in response to that we are trying to scale down the amount of individual and separate threads that we need to view and respond to. As a two/three man development team working full time on the project, it is difficult for us to dedicate time to every thread, comment, and concern. 

We have closed the "Bug Reports" and "Suggestions" forums on Steam. If you would like to report a bug or a suggestion, please do so on our Discord Server: https://discord.gg/5mhbgJh

If you want to stay in touch with development or report a bug these are the best places to do so:

Official Facebook Page: https://www.facebook.com/EmergenycGame/
Official EmergeNYC Community: https://www.facebook.com/groups/445211119186559/
Official Youtube Channel: https://www.youtube.com/user/rafaelmfernandezable
Official Twitter: https://twitter.com/FSGEmergeNYC 

Now on a personal level. Taking on the development of a game this size and this optimistic is very scary. However, the thought of abandoning this project or ripping off the community has never once crossed my mind. As much as I make this game for me, I make it for the thousands and thousands of people who just like me, dreamed of a game like this for so long. I am not a corporation or billion dollar game development company. I'm an individual who stepped up and decided that this is what I was going to do. I was going to take a shot at revolutionizing the Emergency Gaming world. I spent over 5 years teaching myself the basics, and the last 2-3 years putting everything I've learned to use while continuing to learn things everyday. I love what I do. Many of you have watched the countless 10+ hour development livestreams I have done, heard me have mental breakdowns, be hacked, develop new systems and art from the ground up, and everything in between. But for many of you its easy to jump to a conclusion and assume that I am someone trying to steal your money and that I could care less about this game. 

This project does not have an "end date". This is something I see myself continuing to polish, improve, and add to for years after a full release. I want to remind players that we are still in Pre-Alpha, one of the earliest and messiest stages of development. FlipSwitch Games does not have an office building with 50 Gaming PCs and developers everywhere sitting on bean bag chairs. As I write this I am at the same desk that I made my first 3D Model 8 years ago and the same desk that EmergeNYC has been built on. To my standards, EmergeNYC has been succesful. It has been able to support me so that my decision to drop out of college and quit my job to focus on this project was not in vain. In fact, it was the best decision I ever made. You all know my end goal is to become a New York City Firefighter. Until then, this project is my #1 priority. Many of you may have lost trust in this game, which is understandable. 

Development has been slow and messy. What we do want to remind you all, is that we have been extremely transparent with our development. We have taken a unique approach into the game development world. With no investors, or external funding, we had to rely on crowd funding and actual game sales to fund the development of this project. Anyone can see the 35$ price tag, or the early on 50$ price tag and feel that price is injustified, but that is the price we decide to charge for several reasons. That is the main source of the funding I use to pay Donut, our only programmer. That is also the funding I use to live off of, and purchase essentials to speed up the development of the game. Yes, this game is VERY rough, there are constant gamebreaking issues, multiplayer issues, optimization issues, but this all comes with the title "Early Access" & "Pre-Alpha". We don't use the term Pre-Alpha lightly. We want people to understand that. If you are not sure about buying this game at its current state, or are expecting a finished and polished game, you are in the wrong place. I want to reassure everyone that I, nor this project, is going anywhere. If you ever feel like I am scamming you, or this project is a scam, please reevaluate and take some time to see the time and effort I have put into this project. I am always looking to improve my relationship with the community and the state of this game, however I am only human. While last year was the most succesful year of my life, this year has been the worst year of my life. I will not try to write a sob story or go into details about anything but I want people to know that there have been times where I had to take time off from this project for my own mental well being. Depression and ADHD is not a good combination for one, no less two, of our game developers. As for Donut, he lost his mother and father in the last two years and has had his own trials and tribulations. I wish that a billion $ game studio was creating EmergeNYC, but the reality is that they do not see the potential missing in this genre of game/simulation. However, I am willing to risk it all and dedicate hundreds of hours a month till I pull my hair out to improving and advancing this game. With the last 0.7.4 update and EMS/Rescue update right around the corner, I hope you all can continue to ride with me and Donut as we take on this huge undertaking, and while it can be overwhelming at times, we won't stop until we physically cannot continue working. (God Forbid). This is just a fraction of the things I wish our community could understand, but I hope that the future of this project can speak for itself and redeem itself. 

- Raf

notes.title: Update 0.7.3C Live for PC & MAC

Hey everyone, Update 0.7.3C is live for PC & MAC, you heard that right. Last week was hectic. Donut caught the black plague of colds and a mysterious crashing issue plagued the game for several days. The good news is that yesterday we were finally able to fix it.
You will have noticed that throughout the week several updates were given on Steam. These were for some other issues in the game. We have been focused on fixing a lot of multiplayer issues before we continue EMS. We also took some time to tidy up the Fire Academy and fix a bunch of bugs that had not been addressed. This includes a serious performance improvement in the fire academy.
Multiplayer in the fire academy is now a much more enjoyable experience. Fires are synced, as well as Engine Company Operations (Pumps, hoses, water supply, hydrants) etc. We also took time to address some other bugs and reskin some of the spares to look like in service companies. Thanks everyone for your patience as we get the remaining bugs and quirks sorted out, as always please be sure to report bugs to us so we can address them asap!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/461430/

We have revisited a lot of the current systems and improved on many things such as lighting, graphics, game play and more. Also new to EmergeNYC in 0.7.0 are new FDNY and NYPD vehicles including a new Tower Ladder and NYPD Crime Scene Unit. AI Emergency Vehicles can now respond! A new "Optimized map" option is included which removes many of the additional details buildings that may cause some to have performance issues. Traffic has also been worked on to be more optimized and responsive. There is a new optimized city map which we encourage trying out if you have had issues running the city map in the past. 

We want to know what you all want to see next for update 0.8.0! Leave a comment down below! We can focus on the game mechanics for NYPD. Work on the Rescue Update which will add car accidents, water rescues and more. Or we can begin the game mechanics for EMS. Let us know what you want!

We want to remind you all that we are still in Pre-Alpha and this is still a game in the early access testing phase and is patched several times a week to improve game play and performance and address issues and bugs. We are looking to expand our team of developers so that the project can be completed at a faster pace. That means that from now on the reporting of bugs and issues in the game needs to be done in a more organized fashion. Please report bugs and issues in the game in the following fashion:

What is the issue + Steps to replicate the issue 
What is your current version + system specs 
Screenshot or video of the issue

You can view our backlog here and what issues we are currently working on: http://144.217.240.210/FlipSwitchGames/EmergeNYC/boards

Change log for 0.7.0

Major Graphical & Lighting Improvements
New & Improved Traffic AI 
Multiplayer & Networking Improvements & fixes 
AI Emergency Vehicles can now respond to anywhere you send them on the map
New FDNY Trucks and NYPD Vehicles!
New Emergencies!
A completely new & customizable weather and time system
A much less performance intensive Map 
A new Optimized Map option
Unity 2018 Upgrade improves performance and loading times 
Hose Physics optimization (less crashing)
and many many bug fixes.

Hey Steam users! We want to thank everyone who has been participating in the public testing of 0.7.0. We are all aware that it is buggy and sometimes unstable but we have kept up with a daily patch addressing bugs and improving the new AI aspect of the game without excuse. We are aiming on finishing and polishing everything we want and need with the RTS AI, implementing the updated smarter and optimized Traffic AI by the end of this weekend and then moving into focusing on resolving hose crashing issues, multiplayer bugs, and the rest of the game breaking issues. Once again thank you all for your support and patience. 

Tonight's patch is live, today we mostly worked on AI and continued work on the Traffic AI which will be implemented very soon. RTS AI is now smarter to avoid problematic areas like FDR drive and Central Park. They are now much more likely to make it to the scene where you need them without issue however there are still hiccups in the downtown area. It gets better with each patch. In the photo you'll see I have a ton of hose stretched off one truck with no issue. The key to avoiding crashes when using hoses is wait for all vehicles to be stopped and parked before attempting to pull hose. If a vehicle is driving around somewhere and you pull hose, it can lead to a crash. Were working on addressing this. We are aware of the outrigger bug and will fix it tomorrow.

notes.title: Just an Update (Raf)
notes.content: Hey everyone, Raf here. I want to apologize for disappearing off the radar for the last 2 weeks. Unfortunately things out of my control have been happening and I've been going through the darkest days of my life. I don't want anyone to think for a second that this project is not a priority to me. This project is the result of my hard work and dedication as well as others and the communities support for over 6 years. I will never "abandon" this project. More than ever now this project is my priority and work will be continuing to move forward at a much quicker pace than the last 2 months. I am back and I especially want to thank Ionut Pislar for keeping things moving and getting a 0.7.0 private release out. The next step for us is to polish this update and get it out as soon as possible to everyone. I am getting settled back in and am ready to continue where we left off. I want everyone to know that this project is my life and always has been and it will never be "abandoned". The project is back on its feet standing tall and I look forward to rebuilding the communities trust and excitement in the project. Hope those of you who have tried the 0.7.0 update have been enjoying it and we are addressing the issues and bugs you have been reporting.

notes.title: Back in the groove of things
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Raf here. I want to thank everyone for being patient and understanding this past week. My dog was like my son to me and was the only person I lived with. I've taken time to grieve and try to get accustomed to the void that is left in the household. As of today I am back to full time work with Karlo and Donut who have been working hard while I was gone. I look forward to getting back into the project and getting things moving as quickly as they were before. 

Some of the things that were worked on while I was away:

-Major engine upgrade , I finished doing a major upgrade for our engine giving us a lot more flexibility and options specially in terms of graphics and optimization
 -Traffic , been working on a deterministic networked traffic using taking full use of multi-core processors using Unity's new job system
 - Graphics , I have been running a lot of tests and been implementing a custom rendering pipelines for both highend and lowend pc's so people with lowend pc's cand enjoy the game just as much
 - Been testing ILL2CPP builds and been fixing issues to it , this will result in much faster CPU times 
 - I have been refactoring part of the really broken code , (eg venting) for more bug free experience specially related to multiplayer.
 - Started implementing a interactive tutorial framework for Raf , so we can provide a easier learning curve for new players :)
 - Improved graphics , using the new rendering pipelines and unity's light-mapping I been creating a few lightmapping profiles for both low-end and high-end pc ... sadly in order to provide lowend pc-s a major performance boost day/night cycle will be removed , but will still be a option for higher end pc's (realtime GI and stuff )

Most of them have been fixed in this update and the game should be much more enjoyable, however keep in mind that there are still issues as always and we need your bug reports and feedback to improve the game. notes.title: Update 0.6.5 Now Live for PC & Mac
notes.content:
EmergeNYC Update 0.6.5 is now available for PC & Mac

0.6.5 includes:

Performance Improvements
City Map Reintegrated with Emergencies and Fires
Fire Hose Physics & Water Supply Logic
New Items and Equipment
Multiplayer (Still very early w/ lots of issues)
Tons of bug fixes
and much much more...

Please read the opening tutorial on how to use all of the new additions.
 
Please report any bugs to us so we can fix them as soon as possible. There still are a few annoying bugs that we have to fix but we feel like we are way past getting this update out and feel like its worthy now for a public release.

For Testing Branch Users:

0.6.5F Updates

This technically should be update 0.6.5O or something because of the amount of builds and hot fixes we have made. For starters we spent a lot of time completely revamping the hose physics system to be much more optimized and work much smoother without as many bugs. This means if you are not touching or using a hose it will freeze and not process the physics causing much less lag in the game. We also finally got to some very important optimization fixes which you will notice a significant performance improvement in the city map. We added very basic emergency light radiation to give a realistic look and feel but without all of the lag that comes with it. We spent some time working on a new building with interior which we will be doing a lot more as time passes and adding new emergencies to those. Some Multiplayer fixes have been added but will need testing and keep in mind Multiplayer is nowhere near stable or complete. We will need you to send any error or crash logs to Donut on Discord. We will be posting this update on the public branch finally although there are still a few annoying bugs and issues we are still addressing, it is definitely the best build to date. notes.title: Update 0.6.5 Now Live for PC & Mac
notes.content:
EmergeNYC Update 0.6.5 is now available for PC & Mac

0.6.5 includes:

Performance Improvements
City Map Reintegrated with Emergencies and Fires
Fire Hose Physics & Water Supply Logic
New Items and Equipment
Multiplayer (Still very early w/ lots of issues)
Tons of bug fixes
and much much more...

Please read the opening tutorial on how to use all of the new additions.
 
Please report any bugs to us so we can fix them as soon as possible. There still are a few annoying bugs that we have to fix but we feel like we are way past getting this update out and feel like its worthy now for a public release.

For Testing Branch Users:

0.6.5F Updates

This technically should be update 0.6.5O or something because of the amount of builds and hot fixes we have made. For starters we spent a lot of time completely revamping the hose physics system to be much more optimized and work much smoother without as many bugs. This means if you are not touching or using a hose it will freeze and not process the physics causing much less lag in the game. We also finally got to some very important optimization fixes which you will notice a significant performance improvement in the city map. We added very basic emergency light radiation to give a realistic look and feel but without all of the lag that comes with it. We spent some time working on a new building with interior which we will be doing a lot more as time passes and adding new emergencies to those. Some Multiplayer fixes have been added but will need testing and keep in mind Multiplayer is nowhere near stable or complete. We will need you to send any error or crash logs to Donut on Discord. We will be posting this update on the public branch finally although there are still a few annoying bugs and issues we are still addressing, it is definitely the best build to date. notes.title: Happy New Year from FlipSwitch Games! Dev Update
notes.content:
Happy New Year everyone from Raf and the rest of the Team! We are very very close to a public release of 0.6.5. Since our last post the update has improved significantly, especially performance wise. We have optimized hose physics to not cause such a performance hit we have also optimized many other parts of the game to run much smoother and we can't wait to see how it helps you guys when playing the game. The reason we haven't released yet publicly is because we want to make sure everything is as solid as possible before publishing it. 

Remember, you can test the latest version of 0.6.5 on our Steam Testing Branch. 

2018 will be a huge year for us as we plan to take the project to new heights and get a start on EMS and PD game play mechanics. We also plan on making a Rescue update for the firefighting mechanics which will add new calls like water rescues, car accidents, entrapment, and all the equipment needed to handle these emergencies. Virtual Reality is also something we are looking into for this game. Multiplayer will be polished and made enjoyable, and hopefully we can get a start into opening up modding for the game. We have all of these and more on our list and we will get to them as we progress through development. We want to thank every patient and supportive player for hanging with us through this long and arduous development process. This is all possible because of all of you!
