notes.title: Update on 0.6.5 and Progress
notes.content:
0.6.5 will be published public by the end of the year we hope. Our main reason for not releasing yet as is is because we simply feel like it does not deserve the term update yet. Many new things have been added but many new bugs and issues have come as part of that as well. For example these photos look great but while taking them I had only about 5 FPS. Tomorrow and the rest of these days before the update we will be putting all our efforts into Optimizations to increase FPS and reduce loading times, improving hoses and hose physics inside of buildings, and working a lot on the very broken multiplayer.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/f5824595bf1e223354984694279564fa6e6662bc.jpg[/img]

 We are not where we wanted to be by the end of this year but we are still doing it despite all of the negativeness and issues that we have been having while developing the game. One thing that remains is that we have an incredible patient and supporting community which understands the development process of a game like this. 0.6.5 is available on the testing branch on Steam and is getting patched a few times a day. There are many large and small bugs and we focus on fixing the large ones with priority over the smaller ones. I want to thank the community again for being with me through all my 20-30 hour work day/nights these last 2 weeks. For supporting us even when we missed our deadline. Even when our game runs like crap and is barely playable for many 😕 you guys still understand that we (Me, Donut and Karlo) are trying our absolute best and working as hard and quick as we can to fix these issues. I gave up my holidays this year to try to get the game out as early as I possibly could for you guys. Even after being hacked 25 hours into a live stream, even after witnessing an ex girlfriend break into my house on our live stream (Yes our development live streams on Twitch get very crazy), you guys have been the best community we could ask for and we want to thank you and assure you we are doing our best to make the game as playable as it was before. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/03daffa182e89642818f7deece72bb8a4ddea208.jpg[/img]

We already know how we are going to fix these, now it is just about putting in the work to try to fix these issues. Some are easy and some take very very long. (The firehose phyics took an entire 3 months)!!! See you guys tomorrow as we will be patching some optimization physics hopefully to optimize or remove radiation on emergency lights as they cause a lot of lag at an emergency scene and optimize the firehoses to freeze them when you are not interacting with them.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/09fd86a1df4b7a9f6c0d0c44cc6a45db17f4f155.jpg[/img]

Good night/Good morning! 
#CommunityAppreciationPost

notes.title: Update 0.6.5 Testing Branch Open
notes.content:
Hey everyone, after being hacked, a few mental breakdowns, 30 hour work days, and so many setbacks, unforeseen issues, we have gotten the update to a point where we need our players to test for bugs and issues to help us get the update to a good state quicker. We understand frustrations and concerns about performance, multiplayer issues, and broken parts of the game and that is why this is in the testing branch still. We have come up with some new optimization ideas and plan to put those in very soon to help with performance. Please if you have any issues, report them quickly and in detail and we will fix them. 

To access this branch, restart your Steam, right click EmergeNYC in your Steam Library, and select the betas tab. Enter the code: "EmergeNYCAlpha" and click Check Code. Then select the testing branch in the drop down and wait for the game to update.

We will be making a fire academy video today to explain how to use many of the new mechanics.

I want to say thank you to my 2 developers Donut and Karlo who have been putting crazy amounts of work alongside me to get this working for you guys. Thank you to our patient supporters who understand how difficult this is and that we are doing nothing but everything we can to get you guys to enjoy and be able to play the game.

notes.title: December Development Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we really hope you all have been able to enjoy the firefighting update we released at the end of last month. We are 100% aware of all the issues and bugs you are all having and we have already fixed most of them for our next update. We have already begun adding new emergencies and fires back into the city scene to be reimplemented in the next patch as well as complete and functional hose physics, water supply mechanics and more. 

This update will contain alot of fixed and additional content and might as well be 0.7. We can't wait to get a stable and much less buggy update out to everyone and we are getting very close to wrapping up the rest of the firefighting mechanics and reintegrating multiplayer! 

Here are some screenshots of some of the fire environments you will see in the next update. These include churches, vacant warehouses, apartments, stores, garages, auto body repair shops and plenty off outside and underground fires for you to respond to and finally put out at an even better level as the fire academy scenarios. notes.title: Firefighting Mechanics Update 0.6 Live on Testing Branch!
notes.content:
Well after an 8 day delay, well over 60 hours of uninterrupted work this week and atleast 48 hours live streaming in only the last 3 days, we finally have gotten our most significant release to date, Update 0.6 published to our Steam Testing branch for immediate download on PC. MAC to follow. 

*Instructions at the very bottom* 

First things first, this is the first release and I am running on -3 hours of sleep. There will be bugs, things that need to be touched up, and more but otherwise we appreciate your feedback, bug reports, and suggestions. Keep in mind, hose physics are still a WIP. You can currently spray unlimited water from the Nozzle even when not connected to a hose. We are currently writing the logic for limited water, supply lines, and hoses etc. Each engine has an attack line on the front bumper you can release by pressing E nearby. Equip the nozzle and walk to the tip of the hose to connect it. When starting the game as well as loading the scene you will find a menu showing you the new features and how to use them. Please read through all of this before coming to us to ask questions. It is very helpful. We have also added many helpful UI tips to come up to let you know how to play the game. It is very helpful for new people. There is a ton of new stuff in this update and we hope you guys enjoy it. Its time for me & Donut to catch up on life.

notes.title: Update 0.5.5B Live for PC & Mac + Road Map for 2017/2018
notes.content:
Update 0.5.5B hotfix is live for PC & Mac

0.5.5B

Hotfix
Fixed Red Materials on PD
Fixed Parking Brake
Fixed Missing Firehouses

0.5.5

Fixed missing buildings in Mac (?)
Fixed skewing ladder whem extending on 66
Fixed character falling through ground when pressing Z
Removed Air mask feature temporarily until full integration
Fixed being to jump infinately
Should be able to step up most curbs now (?)
Fixed issue when reaching top of ladder getting stuck or falling while still climbing
Fixed 32 and 66 Doors not being able to be opened
Updated to Unity Editor 2017.2


Just a quick road map for you guys as we near the end of the year.

 Right now, our #1 priority, is to finish the majority of firefighting mechanics by the end of the month and hopefully all of the firefighting mechanics by the end of the year. We are still going to be fixing bugs constantly as we continue working on these things. We will be showing fire hose mechanics, engine pump mechanics, and fire hydrant mechanics in our next fire academy video. 

 The Steam Autumn Sale and the Steam Winter Sale will be taking place at the end of November and the end of December. We really want to optimize and finish the fun part of the game so that the many many people who do buy the game, can actually enjoy it at its current state by then to celebrate our 1 year anniversary since putting the game on Steam back in November of last year. Many of you may not notice or appreciate the amount of work that has been done since the first release of the tech demo, but others will have definitely noticed. For the Autumn sale (Thanksgiving Time), EmergeNYC will be available for 35% off for 1 week, and the Winter Sale (Christmas Time) EmergeNYC will be available for 50% off. 

Next year we hope to focus more on the Police side of the game, and now with a solid base game, solid team and an effective strategy, we hope to be able to finish the Police and EMS portions of the game completely by the end of next year. There are a ton of things we can't wait to add such as modding (Steam Workshop), VR, and console releases, but its just a matter of where we can fit these things in most efficiently. Now we have already begun looking into modding support and will take it in steps. Firstly we will start with allowing players to reskin vehicles, buildings and characters, and as we continue learning how we can develop an easy to use modding tool, we will add more functionality and accessibility to it to eventually mod completely new vehicles, maps, and more.

notes.title: Dev Update 10/24/2017
notes.content:
We notice many of you are experiencing a bug where you are unable to spawn a vehicle. The cause of this bug is lack of an internet connection. We will also have a new fire academy demo by the end of the day showing our fire propogation system as well as our WIP on hose lines and fire extinguishing.

notes.title: 0.5.5 Development Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we hope you are all enjoying update 0.5. We decided to shift our focus from multiplayer bug fixing and having that be our priority, to going ahead and finishing implementing the equipment that we have already creaeted with our new character controller. The halligan will help you force doors to gain entry to a building or room. The K12 saw will allow you to gain access to buildings with Roll down doors, cut window bars, cut locks, and perform ventilation. The water and CO2 extinguishers allow you to put out different types of fires whether they be chemical or just rubbish. We are very close to implementing the extinguishment of fires in an update and as most of you have requested this feature for a long time, it is now #1 on our list. 



[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/df31b50e7846493d15f618e96fab52067f4a17ad.jpg[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/362196667b25ff8bf0f0c45768b22de899b4e24e.jpg[/img]


[url=https://gyazo.com/2d787e8a10590401168591b3298479f5][img]https://i.gyazo.com/2d787e8a10590401168591b3298479f5.gif[/img][/url]


[url=https://gyazo.com/9313d714d3ee7e5a537c126b52cf6368][img]https://i.gyazo.com/9313d714d3ee7e5a537c126b52cf6368.gif[/img][/url]

We are aware of those of you with Low End PCs having issues with very long loading times and terrible FPS. All we can tell you for now is to stick to the Fire Academy, upgrade your PC, or be patient while we look for more solutions to optimize the city scene. It is a very large and resource intensive map and has performance issues that come with it. We are constantly brainstorming on ways to improve those loading times and performance. We just ask for your patience and we hope the Fire Academy allows you to still enjoy the game, especially once we reimplement all of this equipment in the next update.

We have been all ears on your bug reports and suggestions and they are all added to our tasks lists. We want to again thank you all for the pateince and support through out our development and we hope you are all as excited for this next update as we are!

Raf

notes.title: Update 0.5 is Live!
notes.content:
Update 0.5

Well everyone, after about 3 months and weeks and weeks of players testing in our public testing branch, we feel like we are way past due a public update to all of our Steam players. This is a significant update and for this change log we are not going to go through each little thing that we did, but go over the highlights of new things that you can find in the game. So without further or due, welcome to Update 0.5.

First thing we would like you to keep in mind is that EmergeNYC is still in the early stages of Pre-Alpha. There are still bugs, optimizations needed to be done, and many new gameplay features to be added. 


Ladders

One of the biggest additions to gameplay that we added in this update was the ability to use and climb portable ladders and Aerial Ladders, as well as use and manuever the Tower Ladder Bucket. You are able to access rooftops, fire escapes, scaffoldings, setbacks, and other areas where any of the ladders can reach. Each engine company comes with a standard extendable ladder while the Ladder companies carry 4 different types and sizes of ladders. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5O04ENR.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wSETzkZ.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QoOrQUU.jpg[/img]

Pics climbing ladders Setting up and carrying portable ladders.

Complete City Map
You will notice in update 0.5 is how much progress we made on our New York City map. If you remember, there were many empty areas, gray blocks, and empty streets. Well now you will find a much more complete map and as we continue to furnish the map with street props, parked cars, pedestrians and more, the city will come to life and the realism aspect will set in even more. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cctTEfA.jpg[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lHYjA9n.jpg[/img]



Something many may appreciate and have requested is an underground environment. The subway plays a huge part in NYC life and emergency services with rescues, EMS calls, and crimes taking place in the Subway systems. This is something we felt was paramount to add to the game and we look forward to showing you the variety of emergencies that you will be dealing with underground. Enjoy and explore the large system that runs under a huge portion of the middle of the map near Times Square. You can find several entrances in the areas near Broadway-6th and 40th St-45th St.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/5nYxMNs.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/INwMun4.jpg[/img]

Refined Character Controller


We also have added a police character with no functionality yet, but it is now the base and start of where we will be moving forward with our Police Character Controller.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1by2CMi.jpg[/img]


You can switch from Third Person to First Person now in the character controller by pressing V at any time. This is a new feature and still requires tinkering and adjustments.

Tons of fixed bugs

You will notice a ton of bug fixes, and things we have reworked and redone because of your suggestions and bug reports. They are invaluable to us so we want to thank all of our patient players and those who have taken the time to report bugs to us! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8HWUHRF.jpg[/img]

New Tower Ladder 68 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MmPkaMx.jpg[/img]

Fire Academy

Many of you have eagerly awaited our Fire Academy Update. We heard your concerns as this update took us much longer than we expected. We have decided to allow players to go ahead and explore the Fire Academy Map which allows people who are struggling with performance in the larger map, to still get to enjoy the game. The Fire Academy will be a place where you can learn how to use all the equipment that we implement into the game, set up drills and scenarios to practice alone or with friends, and study fire behavior when implemented. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/19JU7vT.jpg[/img]


Multiplayer

Multiplayer is being reworked to fix some of the most annoying bugs such as bouncing vehicles, and networking all of the new mechanics we have added. This proccess has taken a little longer than we expected as we continued to find some pretty significant bugs while testing multiplayer. Rather than delay the release of 0.5 even longer, Multiplayer is disabled temporarily. However, if you would like to test, it can be accessed in our testing branch on Steam while we continue to iron it out and make it more stable. 

Free Demo

Many People also ask about the status of a free demo for EmergeNYC. We have published a build and Steam is currently reviewing it before allowing us to release it. This will take a few days. The free demo allows the player to drive one vehicle from each department in the game around the Fire Academy map. 


Controller Support

Those of you with steering wheels and game controllers, we have heard your calls for controller support. We have implemented controller support a long with a control mapper where you can map most of the game controls to specific keys, buttons, mouse buttons, and more. As development continues we plan to eventually allow every aspect of the game to be custom mapped in the control mapper. For now about 1/2 of the games controls are available to be re-mapped. This can be done from the main menu, or in game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HlwYoar.jpg[/img]

UI Overhaul

We completely redesigned our main menu, multiplayer servers UI, in game UI, and much more. We hope this new UI is cleaner and easier for the player to understand. We have also added UI to many aspects of the game where player's could be confused on how to use certain mechanics. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FMJArXT.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/QkElclp.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/uaGMG57.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/YaDBCJv.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Developer Situation Update: Back & Everything Good to Go
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Raf here, I'm back finally. Everything with Hurricane Irma and the FDNY Exam is sorted and I am back at home and working full sail ahead. Our first priority is getting the 0.5 update released publicly with Multiplayer reintegrated and optimization and bug fixes and a Mac release as soon as possible.

Thank you all for your patience and we look forward to getting this release out hopefully this coming week.



Last post incase you missed it: 


"Hey everyone, just an update of what's going on. I (Raf) came to visit family for Labor Day in the Dominican Republic, as many of you may know, A very dangerous hurricane is on path with making landfall in the Dominican Republic within the next 1-2 days. Another one of our developers is evacuating his home state of Florida and is unable to work for the next week or so depending on how things go. I plan to fly back to NY this Saturday to finish studying and take my FDNY exam on Tuesday. After that all my attention will refocus on the project and getting everything moving at the speed it was a week or two ago. Ionut and Karlo however are still working on the project and completed some more optimizations and have finished our portable ladder mechanics ready for demo in a new fire academy video as well as integration into the 0.5.1. Once again, 0.5 can be publicly tested on Steam via our testing beta branch.
We will update you all as soon as we get settled back in."

I (Raf) came to visit family for Labor Day in the Dominican Republic, as many of you may know, A very dangerous hurricane is on path with making landfall in the Dominican Republic within the next 1-2 days. Another one of our developers is evacuating his home state of Florida and is unable to work for the next week or so depending on how things go. I plan to fly back to NY this Saturday to finish studying and take my FDNY exam on Tuesday. After that all my attention will refocus on the project and getting everything moving at the speed it was a week or two ago. Ionut and Karlo however are still working on the project and completed some more optimizations and have finished our portable ladder mechanics ready for demo in a new fire academy video as well as integration into the 0.5.1. Once again, 0.5 can be publicly tested on Steam via our testing beta branch.
We will update you all as soon as we get settled back in."

notes.title: Update 0.5 Public Testing Now Available on Steam
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/pvPAJcW.jpg[/img]

EmergeNYC Update 0.5 is now available for public testing through our Steam beta branch. To access this branch, restart your Steam, right click EmergeNYC in your Steam Library, and select the betas tab. Enter the code: "EmergeNYCAlpha" and click Check Code. Then select the testing branch in the drop down and wait for the game to update.

Please note that this is a testing branch so there will be bugs and we are trying to get an idea of how the game runs across a variety of different systems. Multiplayer is disabled currently but will be re implemented after we fix some networking issues. Single player has the same features as multiplayer. More optimizations and bug fixes will be done before the public release of Update 0.5 on Steam. 

Some of what you can expect: 

Map is now completely filled with buildings (No more gray cubes or large empty spaces) 

Third Person Game play now available in Single Player 

Extensive amounts of work done on asynchronous loading, asset bundles, and streaming to improve loading times, reduce crashes, and improve performance

Characters can now climb apparatus ladders and use the Tower Ladder Bucket

Completely redesigned main menu and ingame UI
New Input Manager allows calibration for controllers and key mapping

Significantly improved third person camera

Added Underground Subway Environment and Emergencies

Emergency Lights can be seen from further away

Sidewalk, map mesh and texture issues fixed

Hundreds of hours of back end work done, bugs fixed, and optimizations made. 

A whole new wave of bugs will come with this update and we are prepared to fix them quickly.  We are also 100% focused now on game play mechanics and firefighting game play now that we almost have got the hardest task (Optimization) out of the way.

notes.title: Development Update #3 - Map work, Input Manager + Controller Support, and More
notes.content:
Hey everyone, another development update here as we near the release of our next update. Along with all the major additions in our 2 previous posts, some of what we have been working on the hardest the last few days is optimizing the project and improving how and where resources are spent. We also spent a ton of time setting up a new input system from the ground up. This will allow you to use different controllers and map your own keys in the game. This has been a much requested feature and we are super excited to finally address it. 

You will be able to do this from the main menu or in game:  

https://i.gyazo.com/25a523d0e94b0d6b188b1c455530e484.mp4

We have also 90% completed the map. We have now added a hospital, moved the positioning of the NYPD Precinct and spent a ton of time setting up emissive windows on all buildings for a much better looking night environment. We still have a ton of work to do on details such as props and individual details in specific areas, but the map no longer has large empty spaces or gray blocks. We also have an extremely helpful tool now that allows us to edit meshes inside of Unity and makes shaping buildings to certain angles to fill oddly shaped blocks, so much easier. We have also brightened all of the dark buildings that were a different shade. All buildings have the same brightness level.

Another team member, Karlo, has been working on simplifying our character system which was previously extremely complex. This will make it much easier and quicker to develop our third person controller. We now have a total of 5 people currently working on the project and are excited to keep expanding. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wTNPwKf.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/geZv9II.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Qp9Ktmo.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/mocIPwP.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Development Update #2 - Major Map Work, Graphical Additions, Gameplay Improvement
notes.content:
Read Original Post + Screenshots: https://www.facebook.com/EmergenycGame/posts/1397973680279919

"Hey everyone, we have been quiet these last few days but we have been hard at work and we have a lot to show for in tonight's WIP showcase. We hope to have all of this complete and implemented in our next update. We have hired a UI artist to help us create better UI and are working on simplifying everything for players. 

Main Menu Optimization Work: https://i.gyazo.com/c6b881a2d03b164cf99d4c34548e6023.mp4

The entire team has been doing a great job working together and sharing ideas and solution to problems very quickly. We have come across great tools that have helped us speed up many aspects of development.  

In this coming update we have fixed a ton of bugs and smoothed out the third person game play to be a lot simpler.

Among many other things you can see, this update I have gotten to spend some time working on my favorite thing which is working on the Map. I love New York City so it is awesome to be getting to recreate something and do so much research and learn so much about the city. I have been working on this map for years and it feels amazing to finally be able to drive around and not see a giant grey cube or a ton of empty spaces. 90% of all building placement in the map is done and the map is starting to look amazing. We plan to go through and add Night lighting to every building eventually. You might notice that we finally touched up our recreation of the 9/11 Memorial and made a recreation of the real park located in Downtown Manhattan. We've added a large park just north of Houston St. and last but not least, we have been really focusing on the Times Square area (One of my favorite areas to spend time in NYC) to make it accurate and detailed to feel just like Times Square. Flashing lights, crowded ambient audio, and heavy amounts of traffic are just some of the major plans we have to make our game be as immersive as possible. 

Hope you enjoy the WIP Screenshots and we can't wait to get this update out to you guys."

notes.title: Development Update - Subway System, Hose Physics, and more!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, to get more in touch with our fan base, today we will begin keeping you all informed of our "to-dos" for upcoming updates. As well as screenshots of what we are working on leading up to updates to get you all more involved in what goes on behind the scenes. 

For our upcoming update for EmergeNYC we are implementing a realistic, complex, and modular subway system and hope to have stations every few blocks for a variety of locations and lay outs. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/lwIs9Ga.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/TpgDskh.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/0W67mRb.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/mEIRqxy.jpg[/img]


This detailed underground environment opens up a lot more options of Emergencies to simulate and challenge the player with. 

We also are reworking the ladder system and how it works.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/OhtOXAk.jpg[/img]

 The player will now go to the back of the truck and access the outrigger controls. Then he will be able to get onto the turn table and maneuver the aerial ladder or tower ladder from there (Or another player besides the driver, from inside the bucket). 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/LsG6Uc6.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/6xfwPES.jpg[/img]


We are getting really close into cracking the most difficult task since the start of our game. Rope/Hose Physics for players to drag, pull, and carry around lengths of hose line.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/Xszp5qN.jpg[/img]

 This is something incredibly hard to simulate without bugging out the physics engine completely. We want to realistically simulate lengths of hose line being able to be stretched, filled with water and maneuvered as well as putting out the fire. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/buyF4nP.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/kqfZdGd.jpg[/img]


Other things:

When you re spawn, you're with the truck or the company wherever they are on the map. 

A helpful UI for keys for things like engine, lights, sirens, horns and other vehicle controls.

Police Officer characters

Much bigger area of the map complete (Only a few empty blocks left!)

Adding the fire academy map for players to explore, still working on character mechanics (Its very complex and difficult to make ourselves) 

We are not setting a time frame for updates anymore but we are always trying to aim for no more than 2-3 weeks max between each update. Life doesn't always cooperate but we are doing our best and we hope you all notice that. 

Raf

notes.title: Update 0.4.5 Live for PC & Mac (Third Person, Optimization + More)
notes.content:
The Steam Summer Sale has ended and EmergeNYC is back its normal pricing of $34.99. We are FINALLY satisfied enough to publish EmergeNYC Alpha Update 0.4.5 publicly to all of our PC and Mac players for testing.
Update 0.4.5 contains a lot of new stuff and fixes! The biggest one being Third Person game play.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/75A001m.jpg[/img]

To try out Third Person Game Play; start a multiplayer game with your friends or by yourself. When the game loads be sure to press Yes or No when asked if you want to load additional details. In this update we took a lot of measures to improve performance, reduce loading times, and reduce the amount of crashes.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/iiIusxp.jpg[/img]

You can then enable any FDNY Vehicles you would like active or disabled in your game at any time by using the Unit Menu which can be toggled whenever. This has been added to improve FPS and overall performance. The less vehicles on the map, the better performance you will have. This gives our players the ability to run the game how they need to, to get the performance they are looking for. When enabling details or vehicles, your game will freeze for a few seconds until loading is complete. Do not click on anything or think that your game is crashing. Be patient. Find your system's limits.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wm3upf5.jpg[/img]

Once you have the vehicles and details you want loaded, press F2 to open the character spawn menu. Here you have the ability to join any company and assume any role on that unit. Once you have selected a company and riding position, press OK.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/yi0gNPQ.jpg[/img]=

You are able to enter vehicles by approaching the door your character should enter and pressing the F Key. You can switch in and out of different Uniforms by pressing the F5 key to bring up uniform options. Helmet and SCBA gear can be donned by pressing the H or J keys.
We are so excited to finally be in our Alpha Stage and for all the exciting things to come in future updates such as NYPD Officers, EMTs, interacting with and handling Emergencies, better Traffic AI and Logic, Pedestrians, Optimization, and many many more exciting things (Like an underground Subway System).

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FYKtKgD.jpg[/img]

This is our first public release of Third Person and just like with any release there will be bugs and issues, however the game is playable and enjoyable and we will be patching the game constantly. We hope you all enjoy this update and we look forward to hearing feedback and suggestions! If you enjoy this update please consider leaving us a positive review on Steam!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/BUzoDTE.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/whqJ5xw.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FYKtKgD.jpg[/img]

With every LODD in the NYPD or FDNY since we began development of EmergeNYC, we have engraved one of NY's finest or bravest's name on one of the vehicle in our game. Sadly last night we lost a member of NY's Finest, the NYPD.

Last night, Officer Miosotis Familia, was shot and killed in the Bronx while sitting in a Mobile Command Vehicle.

To honor and remember her 12 years of service to the city of New York, we have her name permanently painted on one of our RMPs. As well all of the fictional FDNY companies in the game are proudly sporting the NYPD flag and the Police LODD mark over their unit number.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/7lDRlJu.jpg[/img]

We have also started an Official EmergeNYC Community Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/445211119186559/ 

Full Changelog 0.4.5B:

Added

Third Person Gameplay now integrated!
	Includes a full uniform and company position system
	Press F2 to select a position and spawn a character
	Press F5 to change your uniform
	enter the rig with "F"
	Hold MMB or Left Ctrl to see first person view while on foot
	Ride in rigs together such as the tiller and steer the cab and trailer seperately
	Spawn as ladder 75 roof man and walk to back of the tiller trailer near the area where the tiller driver sits and press f. you can now steer the trailer with the A&D keys. (BUGGED)

Decals and decorations to all fire trucks

Major Optimization done to Muliplayer and Single Player Scene

Added Dopler effect to horns and sirens 

Ambient noise when in firehouse is quieter than when outside

Updated UI again to be universal and cleaner

Can lock cursor by pressing Left-Alt

Fixed

Tiller Can now be driven in Multiplayer by 1 player or by two seperate players

Multiplayer Day/Night System Fixed

Fixed floating decals, Central Park sidewalk mapping bug, and weirdly shaded areas of the map + some cracks where you could see water.

removed an ambient noise that always played at start

Graphics overhaul on Weather System ( Sun Shafts no longer as intense)

Anisotropic (Blurry angled textures) Now always forced on

Trees Missing in Single PLayer Scene

Wheel well of 49 no longer see through

All firehouses labeled on Minimap

Fixed a bag inside Ladder 75 sticking out

Fixed prop inside 75 in the firehouse

0.4.5B

Firehouse door click area is now smaller to avoid misclicking

Clouds and weather can now be seen on all cameras

Fixed 66 Officer

Fixed 78 Driver helmet

Fixed Wig Wag lights staying on after turning off Emergency Lights

Tweaked Third Person Camera

Fixed Physics bug causing rig to fly into 2nd floor

Fixed some floating buildings

Fixed weird minimap beacons

Automatically go back to RTS camera when deactivating a vehicle

Fixed Singleplayer Garage doors

Fixed weird sounding sirens

Fixed tiller steering

Fixed Anisotropic Textures

Smoother character movements in MP

Added loading bar to tech demo load

Added memorial text for Officer killed in LOD on 7/4/17

All trucks running NYPD Flag now

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wm3upf5.jpg[/img]

Once you have the vehicles and details you want loaded, press F2 to open the character spawn menu. Here you have the ability to join any company and assume any role on that unit. Once you have selected a company and riding position, press OK.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/yi0gNPQ.jpg[/img]=

You are able to enter vehicles by approaching the door your character should enter and pressing the F Key. You can switch in and out of different Uniforms by pressing the F5 key to bring up uniform options. Helmet and SCBA gear can be donned by pressing the H or J keys.
We are so excited to finally be in our Alpha Stage and for all the exciting things to come in future updates such as NYPD Officers, EMTs, interacting with and handling Emergencies, better Traffic AI and Logic, Pedestrians, Optimization, and many many more exciting things (Like an underground Subway System).

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FYKtKgD.jpg[/img]

This is our first public release of Third Person and just like with any release there will be bugs and issues, however the game is playable and enjoyable and we will be patching the game constantly. We hope you all enjoy this update and we look forward to hearing feedback and suggestions! If you enjoy this update please consider leaving us a positive review on Steam!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/BUzoDTE.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/whqJ5xw.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/FYKtKgD.jpg[/img]

With every LODD in the NYPD or FDNY since we began development of EmergeNYC, we have engraved one of NY's finest or bravest's name on one of the vehicle in our game. Sadly last night we lost a member of NY's Finest, the NYPD.

Last night, Officer Miosotis Familia, was shot and killed in the Bronx while sitting in a Mobile Command Vehicle.

To honor and remember her 12 years of service to the city of New York, we have her name permanently painted on one of our RMPs. As well all of the fictional FDNY companies in the game are proudly sporting the NYPD flag and the Police LODD mark over their unit number.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/7lDRlJu.jpg[/img]

We have also started an Official EmergeNYC Community Facebook Group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/445211119186559/

notes.title: Third Person - Development Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, we would like to start by apologizing to all of you who have been eagerly waiting. Despite the week we had with the loss of a family pet, a missing developer, and a broken PC, we were aiming for a release tonight and last night but each time we do some last minute testing we uncover some major bugs that we had no clue about. We fixed our PC, spent time with family, found our developer Ionut and even hired an additional developer to split the work load. 


 If you follow our social media platforms you may have seen some of the live streams we have done in the last few days.  We have been streaming development live and also third person multiplayer testing gameplay while we test. 


Tomorrow we will be trying to get a beta branch open on Steam to involve more active testing within the players who sign up to participate in our update testing before we publish updates publicly. 


We have been working non stop for 3 days and this next update will show what we have been working for a few weeks now. Were excited for this new milestone in our development as we move from Pre-Alpha to Alpha. Hope you are all excited as we are and we thank you for your patience.

Twitter: https://twitter.com/FSGEmergeNYC

notes.title: Huge 0.3.5 Update is live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! HUGE update for you guys tonight. We wanted to make sure we got a lot done for you all since we had been quiet for a while. Well here we go.

Update 0.3.5

[img]http://i.imgur.com/pLnKJB8.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/Xx9o3P8.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/gKb835w.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/EvX7LGj.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/9yZzLkI.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/3sb4XqM.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/aJjmSQt.jpg[/img]

First thing we would like to address is one of the first things you may notice. We have replaced the Freedom tower with a complete and accurate recreation of the Original World Trade Center Complex. We want to emphasize that this is not done being tasteless or to be disrespectful. This is in honor of the many many victims of the September 11th Attacks, the 1993 bombings, and the people who are continuing to be lost because of 9/11 related illnesses. We wanted to make the World Trade Center as a memorial and to put them back where they have always belonged, in the NY Skyline. If anyone has an issue with this or feels like it is beyond disrespectful, please contact us. No emergencies whatsoever will take place at the buildings. 
We have also added incredible looking night lights to many of the new buildings including the World Trade Center. Night lighting is now automatically turned on after 6PM game time until 6AM. 

We have also added an MDT Feature which allows you to view emergency call information, addresses, and the units assigned. We created it based on the actual MDTs that the FDNY use today. Eventually we will add more features such as buttons to acknowledge a run or put yourself in service. 

One of the main things you will notice in this update is the improvement in Performance. We added the settings menu back in game which can be opened in the action bar on the top right. A new slider has been added call "Render Distance", with this new option, you can gain up to 30 frames by lowering it! By default it is all the way down. I am now getting around 120 FPS at start.

We also synced and networked police vehicle customization and light bars. We apologize for the issue with being unable to use NYPD Vehicles in the last update. 

Check out the full change log for more

Chang log 0.3.5

Added feature for night lights on buildings to automatically turn on and off depending on time of day

Fixed Single Player Emergencies not disappearing

Added MDT (Press F1) This gives you all the information on the emergency you are responding to

Added dozens of new buildings and landmarks including the Old World Trade Center Complex

Re added the Settings menu in game

Major Performance Improvements

Traffic AI now works and is synced for Multiplayer

Spawning Police Vehicles working again

Customization of PD Cars and Light bars (F2) are now synced in Multiplayer

Tiller Trailer now works again in Single Player

Ladder 75 Trailer Lights work again

Added Steam Validation to prevent pirating of game

Fixed Generator Sticking out of Ladder 75

Bug Report button fixed

Restart Scene button fixed in Single Player

Fixed sunken hydrants and Light poles along Lower Broadway

Added Render Distance to settings menu (Big performance improvement)

Fixed Purple NYPD Light bars


Mac Support for 0.3.5 coming soon

notes.title: 0.3.2 + Dev Update
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/W2GJM99.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/LeENwZE.jpg[/img]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/QZdgz3h.jpg[/img]

Change Log 0.3.2

Complete Graphics Overhaul (W.I.P)
New More Advanced Weather System
Performance Improvements
Added many many more buildings to the map
Added some new emergencies
Fixed misaligned fire on 60th and CPW

New Forum is Live: http://emerge-nyc.com/forum/

(We apologize for not putting this out yesterday or earlier, lots of personal things going on right now)

We are extremely happy and thankful to all of you who have left positive reviews on our Steam since the last post we made. It has really boosted our morale and enthusiasm on the project that we have such great supporters who have faith in us and in the project. 0.3.2 is live and includes a ton of new buildings filling out more areas of the map. The map is coming together nicely and we hope to have it completely filled in with buildings soon. Every single area will then be passed over adding details such as street props, trees, parks. unique plazas, elevated areas and more. Our main priority is replacing all our untextured cubes with more visually satisfying buildings no matter how low quality or low poly they are, they are definitely 100 times better than what we have now. We are now about 60% complete with filling out the map with buildings. The next update we plan to fill out a majority of times square.

Simultaneously we are transferring our character controller and networking it over to what we have multiplayer and single player to add a completely new game mode. You will now be able to be in charge of a single character with a specific role in one of our fire companies and eventually take the role of a police officer or EMT/Paramedic. No two fire crews are the same. Over 20 unique and different Firefighter characters each with a position to take. We have a lot more that we want to talk about this but we will leave it for next week. For now, enjoy these WIP Screenshots.

After tons of stress and headaches we think we may have found an optimal solution to performance issues. The technique is called asset bundling and should definitely help with performance. It will take us some time to implement it fully but we are hopeful it is what we have been looking for to cure this plague of performance issues. If you're having low FPS and long loading times, we really hope this solution works for you and we are excited for you all to test it out when its ready.

notes.title: Dev Update 04/24/17
notes.content:
Hey everyone, hope all of you had a great weekend and enjoyed playing some of the rough draft of Multiplayer that we delivered this week. Big things are coming. We are incoporating all of what we have done in the fire academy into multiplayer so that you and your friends can control individual firefighters and eventually police officers and paramedics, hop in and out of vehicles and handle emergencies. We will announce more information on this new update and it is what we will be working on in the next week or two. 

Also, lately we have been getting bad reviews on Steam which is understandable. People are complaining about performance, loading times, and saying that the game is horrible and not even worth 10$. This hits us hard especially after the countless hours we put into it. We have decided we are going to lower the price of the game to 25$ indefinitely sometime this week and really focus on those issues. Loading screens has been an issue we have been unable to figure out since we started working on the game, and performance has always been a problem that we have been plagued with since the start as well. We have realized that if we cannot address these things before anything else, than the road ahead is grim. We just want you all to know that we know the issues you all are having and we are working hard on getting them fixed. 

Be patient and keep your faith in us, and please if you enjoy the game, it would help us a lot if you leave us a good review on Steam. 

We will be doing updates to the current multiplayer build throughout this week with more buildings, environment additions, and emergencies.

Raf

notes.title: Multiplayer Update 0.3.0 Live!
notes.content:
EmergeNYC Pre Alpha Update 0.3.0 including Multiplayer and much more is now live on Steam for our PC users!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/461430/

In 0.3.0 our main focus was giving you all more than just another small patch with bug fixes but no big additions. Our last big update added a completed street map with highways, bridges, parks, tunnels and more. While many of you may think the pace that we are moving at is dreadful and that we are not accomplishing anything and our efforts are in the wrong place, you have no idea the amount of work and money that goes into this project.

In 0.3.0 we hope you can see where some of that time, effort, focus and money has gone. We have filled out many more parts of the map with new buildings and we have added new random emergencies that give you something to respond to. We plan on adding up to 20 new emergencies every update and currently have 30 or so different ones. This will keep the variety fresh and help you avoid from responding to the same things too many times.

Multiplayer is the main addition in this update to EmergeNYC. This feature is still in development but gives you and your friends the chance to race to randomly generated emergencies and ride together. All vehicles available in the tech demo are available for you to use. To take ownership of a vehicle you must be the first one to select it via the side menu or by clicking on it from the birds eye camera. Any other players who select the vehicle after it has already been selected will join as passengers. This will allow them to cycle through first person or exterior views, and use sirens and horns, but not steer or control the vehicle until it has been released by the original player. 

You can either wait for all players to join your lobby before starting a game, or you can start the game and players can join in progress. Your screen may be black for about 20 seconds once you are loaded in. This means that the host/master of the game is still loading. Once they have loaded into the game, your game will freeze for another 10-15 seconds then you will be able to begin playing. Random emergencies begin after 5 minutes.

Feel free to come and join us for some multiplayer games on the FlipSwitch Games Discord where we constantly hold serious RP games with developers and the most realistic FDNY and NYPD multiplayer group out there.
https://discord.gg/5mhbgJh

Known bugs we plan to fix in weekly patches and hot fixes:
Single Player:

Tiller Trailer Lights are broken
2 or 3 floating buildings

Multiplayer:

Weird issues when sharing a vehicle and the passenger attempts using the manual sirens
When voting to kick someone, it only shows the updated count in the chat
Police vehicle light bars to not light up like the rest of the vehicle
Police vehicle customization is not networked yet
Traffic is not networked yet (Players can turn on traffic on their own game but it will not be synchronized, this is something we are working on now)
Firehouse gates get de synced a lot of the time.

The Asset streaming optimization technique we incorporated, while reducing stress on the system with VRAM and RAM, it did not do much for FPS and would cause terrible lag spikes so we have left it out until we can further work on it and find better ways to use this system. Optimization has been done in the form of compressing textures and occlusion culling but we will not know how much of an impact it has made until we hear from you guys.

Our plans from here include working on the fire academy but not only that, we want to incorporate what we have done with our character controller and merge it with our tech demo mechanics allowing players to get in and out of their vehicles with a firefighter character. We will explain more of how this will work in the tech demo and multiplayer very soon! In the mean time enjoy playing with your friends and responding to fires and other emergencies!

Still planned for Multiplayer:

Steam Integration (Invite friends through Steam)
Complete police vehicle and customization synchronized
Networking Traffic AI
and more

notes.title: Happy Easter + Development Status Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Raf here

As many of you may have noticed, we have begun moving from weekly updates to monthly updates. This is because we have been working on getting something big out to you guys. It has taken us much more time than we expected but we promise this next update will be worth it. It will include many new and exciting things that will definitely improve your overall game play experience. 

For one, Multiplayer will be a new option for all of our players so that you can play with your friends or even strangers and respond to emergencies together.

Second, a variety of random emergencies you can respond to have been added into the game including fires, vehicle accidents, automatic alarms, manhole fires, smoke conditions, large scale disasters and more, as well as a dispatching system that sends a tone to each firehouse and unit that should be responding to said emergency.

Third, we have worked tirelessly on optimization. We have compressed every texture in the game and created an asset streaming system to significantly reduce loading times, lag, RAM, and VRAM usage on your system.

Next, large portions of the map have been filled in with new buildings giving the city a much more fulfilling look.

We have also fixed many many bugs that you have all been pointing out and reporting and for that, we thank you. We also want to thank you all for your patience and support in these quiet and slow days, but we promise you, we have been working our Butts off! 

This update will be coming much sooner than you think! 

Happy Easter Everyone!

Raf

notes.title: Patch 0.2.8
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26753975/da81c09afe571d5576ed618bbb6363ce1d3ab7bd.jpg[/img]

In 0.2.8 we added many cool new and noticeable things.
For one, for our players struggling with FPS. We have added a toggle on the left of the screen titled "Low FPS?" When checked additional options will appear, allowing you to disable individual FDNY Vehicles and Streetlight radiation. This reduces stress on your CPU and GPU allowing for smoother game play. Central Park has also had a major overhaul. We have now removed misplaced trees and grass, and added new details and sidewalks. We have improved optimization when in the park or looking at the park. We have finally added streetlights and traffic lights throughout most of the map which add a certain lighting and ambience visually improving the game. We expect the entirety of the traffic lights and street lights to be placed by next Sunday's update.

Changed design of Weather UI
and more..

notes.title: Our Most Exciting Week Yet! Update 2.5
notes.content:
Hi everyone, some of you may have already heard that we needed to postpone our Multiplayer release once more. We understand any frustration or disappointment but it was needed. We got 80% of the multiplayer networking done in a week and we had high hopes that we would be able to have everything ready by tonight, until we ran into a big issue when networking the traffic AI. The server was getting overloaded when more than 2 people joined. We have since fixed this but it set us back 3 days. We hope you all can be patient as we wrap it up. We are more anxious than all of you to get this out.

Today however, we can still bring you our much anticipated tech demo update with an entirely updated and redone map. Now is where we get to really start working on the map details and buildings. We spent the last 2 months building the base map and we really did it this time. We hope you enjoy the finally completed base map with highways, tunnels, parks and more.
Our next fire academy video and multiplayer will be released on the same date which we estimate will be sometime around Wednesday or Thursday, no promises.

Enjoy Update 2.5

notes.title: 02/19/17 Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone!


We will be live streaming some gameplay of the new map at 2PM EST tomorrow.

(Photos on our facebook page): 

https://www.facebook.com/EmergenycGame/posts/1251105004966788

Here for your weekly progress report/update. Unfortunately there will not be an game update this week either. We are still working hard on implementing the new map into the game and it is looking amazing. We spent this week adding over 1000 individual traffic lanes and redesigning the traffic AI and traffic system. One of our developers has been redesigning the AI and how they react to emergency vehicles which will make for much smoother and easier navigation throughout the city. We have also redone our traffic light system meaning traffic lights are synced up with traffic to let you know when you are actually coming up to a red light. All in all, game play will be much smoother, realistic, and enjoyable.

An update on our next fire academy video, our lead developer has been finishing up a new and improved fire system which includes all the things we mentioned in our indie gogo funding goal (flash overs, back drafts, smoke conditions, ventilation, fire intensity etc) So far, it looks amazing and were excited to preview it. The basic fire extinguisher ability is done with animations and all, we are currently rigging and animating the water extinguisher now and the video should be ready by Sunday. This will show parts of our fire system and some of the different types of fires and how to put them out. 

An update on the multiplayer side of things. Things are not good. Back in October during the Indiegogo campaign we contracted an individual to network our tech demo to allow it to be played online with other players. Due to terrible communication and the inability to meet any of our deadlines, we have cut him off the project and as of Monday we will be bringing on a professional networking developer who will remain on the project full time now that we can afford one. We cannot say how long this will delay the multiplayer milestone for the tech demo, but we can say it will be a much better functioning product in the end and we apologize for this situation. It has upset me deeply but it is time to keep moving and start again with a better developer. Once we have a better idea of how long the development will take on this, we will update you all.

See you all next Sunday!

notes.content:
Patch 0.1.4 is live

A full update will be worked on all week and released Sunday. Patches will be made throughout the week to address more issues and bugs that we find. 

Attached below are some progress photos of our fire academy buildings (Map does not represent final product) Only the buildings are nearly complete.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZGBn9Kp.jpg[/img]

Changelog 0.1.4

0.1.4 is a patch addressing mostly performance issues and some of the more obvious bugs. 

Temporarily removed ability to open doors and compartments (Huge hit on FPS, looking into more efficient ways in the mean time)
Fixed Automatic Sirens on Engine 32
Fixed Minimap and Compass not set correctly at start with Engine 32
Fixed Loud Door Closing sound on start
Fixed Engine 32 headlights and interior lights being always disabled
Fixed Chrome appearing black for some users (We think)
Fixed Generator sticking out of L75 Trailer
Fixed Unalligned LED on 66 Truck
Added proper diamond plate metal shader throughout Squad 28
Moved St Mooks ambulance from inside of building
Fixed Black doorhandles on Crown Vic
Fixed weird overlapping of EQ2B siren on E32 while winding down
Fixed Stuttering Compartments on Tower Ladder 68
Fixed E32 Driver Door swinging open on sharp turns
Fixed massive lag when going into turntable ladder mode (Had to do with two cameras being active rendering everything twice)
Reduced Emergency Light radiation on fire vehicles by over 50% (Was way too high)

To do in next patch

Implement new chase camera (Follows turns of vehicle)
Fix Tiller Trailer Physics
Fix radiation on EMS and Police Vehicles
Spawning system for EMS and PD vehicles so that they are not all constantly spawned on the map.
Look into fixing choppy/laggy/distorted audio sometimes when running EmergeNYC. (Temporary fix is to restart the game or your computer and close background applications until you notice the issue go away). We believe this has to do with memory leaks and it is a priority to fix. 
More..

notes.title: Update 0.1.2 is Live
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/VjySFci.jpg[/img]

[img]http://i.imgur.com/O0GYKE4.jpg[/img]

The update that we delayed twice, is finally up and ready for you guys to play. This includes 11 new EMS vehicles, 8 Police Vehicles and several changes to gameplay.
For one, you can now toggle camera movement with the middle mouse button. When toggled you are allowed to move the camera freely with the mouse, when not toggled, you must hold down the right mouse button to rotate the camera.
A few other things have been addressed but with a new update, comes a wave of new bugs, performance issues, and problems to complain about. We get that and we understand. We will spend the rest of tonight, tomorrow, and the rest of the week patching the game, fixing bugs, and completing things that we did not get to polish 100%.
As an early access tester we hope you appreciate the things that do work smoothly and all of the new things that we have added, and understand that this is a constant work in progress. Enjoy guys!

Mac OS Update will be up by the morning. Still waiting on that build to get sent over. 

FREE & STANDARD EDITION INTERACTIVE DEMO COMING LATER THIS WEEK.

If you would like to report a bug, here is the best place to do so: http://steamcommunity.com/app/461430/discussions/0/224446614459338023/

notes.title: NYPD Update delayed.... Again
notes.content:
With the hectic week since release. It felt as if we had no time at all to really put into the next update featuring NYPD vehicles. The last thing we want to do is rush this release and half ass it. We want it to be just as special as the FDNY tech demo to our police fans. For now, to be safe, we will say that the NYPD and EMS Updates will both be live on Sunday the 13th. This is gives us time to really polish what we want to release to you guys. We guarantee it will be worth the extra few days wait and will be both updates packed into one.
We will also be fixing bugs, and tweaking things such as the camera, handling, optimization tweaks and more.

We apologize for another delay but we want to make sure we have the best product for you guys that we can and don't want to rush it too quickly.

notes.title: Sunday Update Delayed (Please Read)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JGTzO6c.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone, just a progress report. For several reasons this Sunday's NYPD update will be delayed a few days. An NYPD officer was shot and killed today in the Bronx and we want to allow some time before putting out our update. FlipSwitch Games sends its condolences to the officer and his family. These LODD deaths are occurring to often and it's never any easier for the departments.

This is also because my birthday is today, for those of you who don't know, I spent 24/7 working on the tech demo the whole month of October and now friends and family are asking me to come out of the hole I have been in the last 50 days to celebrate the tech demo launch, and my birthday.

MAC USERS: We are still working on getting a working Mac version of the tech demo up and running for you guys. These last few days have been hectic with the release and the amount of customer interaction we have had to have and I want to specially shout out Austin, Ed, Steven, and Jose from our support team on their outstanding voluntary work. I can't do this without them.
